punctuated:
《萬曆十一年進士登科錄》

玉音

萬曆十一年三月初三日，禮部尚書臣徐學謨等於皇極門奏為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中三百五十名。本年三月十五日殿試，合擬讀卷官及執事等官，少師兼太子太師吏部尚書中極殿大學士張四維等五十六員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士張四維〔癸丑進士〕。
光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、戶部尚書、武英殿大學士申時行〔壬戌進士〕。
光祿大夫、太子太保、禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士余有丁〔壬戌進士〕。
translation_en:
Record of Winning the Metropolitan Graduate Degree in the Eleventh Year of the Wanli Reign (1583)

Imperial Pronouncement

On the third day of the third month of the eleventh year of the Wanli reign (March 26, 1583), the Minister of Rites, your servant Xu Xuemo 徐學謨, and others presented a memorial at the Gate of Imperial Supremacy (Huangji men) regarding the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from across the empire, three hundred and fifty candidates have been selected as successful. For the Palace Examination on the fifteenth day of the third month of the present year (April 7, 1583), it is fitting to nominate fifty-six officials, headed by the Junior Preceptor concurrently serving as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Supremacy (Zhongji dian), Zhang Siwei 張四維, to serve as Readers of the Examination Papers and administrative functionaries. As for the grades and status of the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), in reverent accordance with the qualifications imperially established by the Grand Progenitor, Emperor Gao (Taizu Gao Huangdi): in the First Class, following precedent, three candidates are selected, with the first-place candidate accorded rank 6b and the second- and third-place candidates accorded rank 7a, all granted the degree of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); those in the Second Class are accorded rank 7b and granted the degree of Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); and those in the Third Class are accorded rank 8a and granted the degree of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen). We received the Sacred Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Readers of the Examination Papers (Dujuan guan)
Zhang Siwei 張四維, Grandee of the First Class (Guanglu dafu), Pillar of State (Zhuguo), Junior Preceptor concurrently serving as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Supremacy [metropolitan graduate of the guichou year, 1553].
Shen Shixing 申時行, Grandee of the First Class, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently serving as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Revenue, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Prowess (Wuying dian) [metropolitan graduate of the renxu year, 1562].
Yu Youding 余有丁, Grandee of the First Class, Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Rites concurrently serving as Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Profundity (Wenyuan ge) [metropolitan graduate of the renxu year, 1562].

translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors

Eleventh year of the Wanli era (1583):
Early in the morning on the fifteenth day of the third month, the tribute scholars proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. His Majesty took his seat in the Hall of Imperial Supremacy (Huangjidian) and personally bestowed the policy question.

Early in the morning on the eighteenth day of the third month, the civil and military officials attended in court dress in their respective ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-uniform Guard set out the imperial insignia along the Cinnabar Steps and within the Cinnabar Courtyard. His Majesty took his seat in the Hall of Imperial Supremacy, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names on the roll. Officials of the Ministry of Rites carried the yellow placard, led by drums and music, out beyond the Left Chang'an Gate. Once it had been posted, officials of Shuntian Prefecture escorted the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with ceremonial parasols and a retinue.

On the nineteenth day of the third month, …

translation_en:
… bestowed a banquet at the Ministry of Rites. After the banquet concluded, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial to rehearse the court rituals.

On the twenty-first day of the third month, the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) was bestowed court robes, a cap, and a belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).

On the twenty-second day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led all the metropolitan graduates in submitting a memorial to express gratitude for Imperial grace.

On the twenty-third day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led all the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai). The Ministry of Rites submitted a memorial requesting that the Ministry of Works be commanded to erect a stone stele inscribed with their names at the Directorate of Education.

朱國祚〔貫太醫院官籍，浙江嘉興府秀水縣人，順天府學生，治《書經》，字兆隆，行三，年二十五，八月二十五日生〕。曾祖恭；祖彩〔贈登仕佐郎、太醫院吏目〕；父儒〔修職郎、太醫院御醫〕；嫡母唐氏，生母王氏。具慶下。兄國禎、國賢、國祥、國士、國臣，弟國禮。娶何氏。順天府鄉試第十九名，會試第二百四名。

李廷機〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字爾張，行一，年四十二，九月二十二日生〕。曾祖敏輔；祖璞；父宗禹；母陳氏。永感下。弟廷材、廷柱。娶林氏。順天府鄉試第一名，會試第一名。

劉應秋〔貫江西吉安府吉水縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字士和，行三，年三十五，十二月二十三日生〕。曾祖文鳴；祖方興〔推官〕；父子武；母羅氏。具慶下。兄應春、應夏，弟應冬、應程、應秩。娶楊氏。江西鄉試第一名，會試第二百十九名。
translation_en:
First Class (diyijia), three candidates: Conferred the status of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi).

Zhu Guozuo 朱國祚 [registered in an official household of the Imperial Academy of Medicine, native of Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Prefectural Student of Shuntian Prefecture; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhaolong, third in generational seniority, aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Gong 恭; his grandfather was Zhu Cai 彩 [posthumously honored as Courtesan for Ceremonial Service (dengshi zuolang), Chief Steward of the Imperial Academy of Medicine]; his father is Zhu Ru 儒 [Gentleman for Good Service (xiuzhilang), Imperial Physician of the Imperial Academy of Medicine]; his principal mother is Lady Tang, and his birth mother is Lady Wang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Guozhen, Guoxian, Guoxiang, Guoshi, and Guochen, and his younger brother is Guoli. He married Lady He. He ranked nineteenth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and two hundred and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Tingji 李廷機 [registered in a civilian household of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Erzhang, first in generational seniority, aged forty-two, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Minfu 敏輔; his grandfather was Li Pu 璞; his father was Li Zongyu 宗禹; and his mother was Lady Chen. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Tingcai and Tingzhu. He married Lady Lin. He ranked first in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yingqiu 劉應秋 [registered in a civilian household of Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; County Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shihe, third in generational seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Wenming 文鳴; his grandfather was Liu Fangxing 方興 [Prefectural Judge (tuiguan)]; his father is Liu Ziwu 子武; and his mother is Lady Luo. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yingchun and Yingxia, and his younger brothers are Yingdong, Yingcheng, and Yingzhi. He married Lady Yang. He ranked first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Kun 張坤 [registered as a commoner in Zhongxiang County 鍾祥縣, Chengtian Prefecture 承天府, Huguang 湖廣; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Bojian 伯簡; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-four; born on the fourth day of the first month]. He placed 61st in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 122nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhixuan 劉志選 [registered as a commoner in Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; supernumerary student of the county school; specialized in the Book of Odes; courtesy name Kexuan 可選; fifth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-three; born on the second day of the ninth month]. His mother (stepmother) is living, while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhiye 志業 [Surveillance Vice Commissioner], Zhiyi 志伊 [Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review], Zhiru 志儒, Zhixue 志學, Zhizai 志在 [tribute student], Zhishu 志述, Xianchong 憲寵 [tribute student], Zhiyan 志儼, and Mengshang 夢裳; his younger brother is Zhiying 志偀. He is married to née Luo 羅氏. He placed 79th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 22nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Rong 麻溶 [registered in a military household in Xuancheng County, Ningguo Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); added student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Mingzhi; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Tai 泰; his grandfather was Ma Yusi 俞四; his father was Ma Zhi 植 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his legal mother was Lady Lu, and his birth mother was Lady Xing. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Ma Ying 瀛 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner], Ma Su 潚 [Student of the Directorate of Education], Ma Han 涵 [Usher in the Court of State Ceremonial], and Ma Shen 深. He married Lady Xu. He ranked 93rd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 15th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xuan 王萓 [registered in a civilian household in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; student of the county school; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Jiru; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six; born on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Chong 珫 [Assistant Department Magistrate]; his grandfather was Wang He 峉 [District Magistrate]; his father was Wang Jiao 交 [Vice Minister of the Nanjing Court of the Imperial Stud]; his father's former wife was Lady Fei, and his mother is Lady Xue. His mother is alive. His elder brothers are Wang Jin 藎 [Student of the Directorate of Education], Wang Qi 芑, Wang Ming 茗, Wang Quan 荃, Wang Tiao 苕, Wang Rui 芮, Wang Peng 芃, and Wang Jin 菫; his younger brothers are Wang Tong 茼, Wang Ru 茹, and Wang He 荷. He married Lady Chen, and subsequently married Lady Bao. He ranked 44th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 4th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sheng Wannian 盛萬年 [registered in an artisan household in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Minqi; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine; born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Sheng Song 嵩 [posthumously honored as Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Justice]; his grandfather was Sheng Zhou 周 [Prefect]; his father is Sheng Weiqian 惟謙; and his mother is Lady Tao. Both parents are alive. His younger brothers are Sheng Wanshan 萬善, Sheng Wanlu 萬祿, Sheng Wanzhong 萬鍾, Sheng Wanling 萬齡, Sheng Wanchun 萬春, Sheng Wanjian 萬鑑, and Sheng Wanshi 萬石. He married Lady Wu. He ranked 30th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 187th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Jixun 史記勳 [registered in a civilian household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Jishu; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty; born on the thirtieth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Yan 鷃 [Vice Prefect]; his grandfather is Shi Gui 桂 [Student of the Directorate of Education, honored with the title of Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy]; his father is Shi Quan 銓 [District Magistrate]; and his mother is Lady Qian. Both parents and grandparents are alive. His younger brothers are Shi Jihua 記華, Shi Jigong 記功, Shi Jichun 記純, Shi Jixu 記緒, Shi Jicheng 記成, and Shi Jizong 記綜. He married Lady Zheng. He ranked 14th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 175th in the Metropolitan Examination.

張甲徵〔貫山西平陽府蒲州，軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字懋一，行一，年三十一，四月十一日生〕。曾祖誼〔累贈光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士〕，祖允齡〔累封光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士〕，父四維〔光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士〕，母王氏〔累封一品夫人〕。重慶下。弟泰徵〔禮部員外郎〕、定徵〔中書舍人〕、久徵、善徵、元徵、獻徵、性徵、吉徵、光徵。娶楊氏。山西鄉試第二名，會試第一百四十一名。
translation_en:
Mo Rui 莫睿 [registered in Qiantang County 錢塘縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江, of commoner status; a student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (Guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Siqing 思卿; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the seventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Mo Yu 莫瑀; his grandfather was Mo Zongfu 莫宗復; his father was Mo Wenchang 莫文昌; his legal mother was Lady Yang 楊氏, and his birth mother was Lady Shen 沈氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Mo Shu 莫曙, Mo Yong 莫庸, and Mo Yi 莫易. He married Lady Song 宋氏, and subsequently married Lady Zhou 周氏. He placed 1st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 93rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Menglin 史孟麟 [registered in Yixing County 宜興縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), of commoner status; a County Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jiming 際明; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the sixth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Bi 史弼; his grandfather was Shi Ji 史笈; his father is Shi Baode 史褒德; and his mother is Lady Huang 黃氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Shi Zhonglin 史仲麟, Shi Shulin 史叔麟, Shi Jilin 史季麟, Shi Xianglin 史祥麟, Shi Ruilin 史瑞麟, and Shi Wenlin 史文麟. He married Lady Xu 徐氏. He placed 9th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 94th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Shaoyong 林紹用 [registered in Yongfu County 永福縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建, of commoner status, a native of Min County 閩縣; an Auxiliary Student of the Yongfu County School; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shangqing 尚卿; ninth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-one, born on the tenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Tingzhi 林廷植 [Instructor]; his grandfather is Lin Chunsheng 林春生; his father is Lin Jizhi 林繼志 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; and his mother is Lady Zheng 鄭氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Lin Qifeng 林起鳳 [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Lin Shaorui 林紹瑞, and Lin Shaoyong 林紹庸; his younger brothers are Lin Shaozong 林紹宗, Lin Shaoying 林紹英, Lin Shaoyi 林紹奕, and Lin Shaogong 林紹功. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed 35th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jiazheng 張甲徵 [registered in Puzhou 蒲州, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西, of military status; a student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (Guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Maoyi 懋一; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Yi 張誼 [successively posthumously honored as Grandee of the Third Class (Guanglu dafu), Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Extremity (Zhongji dian)]; his grandfather is Zhang Yunling 張允齡 [successively ennobled as Grandee of the Third Class, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Extremity]; his father is Zhang Siwei 張四維 [Grandee of the Third Class, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Extremity]; and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏 [successively ennobled as Lady of the First Rank]. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Taizheng 張泰徵 [Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites], Zhang Dingzheng 張定徵 [Drafter in the Central Drafting Office], Zhang Jiuzheng 張久徵, Zhang Shanzheng 張善徵, Zhang Yuanzheng 張元徵, Zhang Xianzheng 張獻徵, Zhang Xingzheng 張性徵, Zhang Jizheng 張吉徵, and Zhang Guangzheng 張光徵. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed 2nd in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 141st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Xianggao 葉向高 (registered in a military household in Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jinqing; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Ye Shiyan; his grandfather was Ye Guangbin; his father is Ye Chaorong (Department Magistrate); his father's former wives were Lady Guo and Lady Kang; his mother is Lady Lin. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Ye Xiangliang, Ye Xiangyong, and Ye Xiangheng. He married Lady Yu. He placed 25th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 78th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Shaoxian 王紹先 (registered in a civilian household in Sanyuan County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, and a native of Xianning County; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Bosheng; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twelfth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Wang Mao (Prefect, posthumously promoted through successive grants to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Nanjing Minister of Personnel concurrently serving as Academician of the Hanlin Academy); his grandfather is Wang Yongxian (Assistant County Magistrate); his father is Wang Changgong (Confucian Official); his mother was Lady Qin; his stepmother is Lady Liu. Both grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Shaoji, Wang Shaoji, and Wang Shaoqing. He married Lady Luo. He placed 15th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 179th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zuo 王佐 (registered in a civilian household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yiqing; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wang Qi; his grandfather was Wang Ming; his father was Wang Luan; his mother was Lady Rong; his stepmother is Lady Zhu. His stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Wang Bi and Wang You (Sacrificial Attendant). He married Lady Zhang. He placed 82nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 29th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Zhenmo 陸鎭默 (registered in a civilian household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Hougong; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the thirteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Lu Yuan; his grandfather was Lu Xian; his father was Lu Wenhua; his mother was Lady Zou. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Lu Mengxiong (Director of a Bureau in the Nanjing Ministry of Works) and Lu Wei. He married Lady Hu. He placed 23rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 61st in the Metropolitan Examination.

饒伸〔貫江西南昌府進賢縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷抑，行三，年二十六，五月十八日生〕。曾祖桂，祖纁，父汝楫，母劉氏。重慶下。兄廷錫〔知縣〕、崙〔同科進士〕、位〔知縣〕、任、儒、佑，弟傳、倬、倣。娶晏氏。江西鄉試第二十九名，會試第一百二十名。

蔡應麟〔貫福建泉州府晋江縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子瑞，行二，年二十八，六月十七日生〕。曾祖寬〔贈通議大夫、戶部左侍郎〕，祖祐〔教授，封主事，贈通議大夫、戶部左侍郎〕，父克廉〔南京戶部尚書〕，嫡母留氏〔累封夫人〕，生母陳氏。慈侍下。兄顯宗〔恩例冠帶〕、振宗、纘宗〔州吏目〕、懋宗、應龍〔官生〕，弟應辰、應陽。娶楊氏。福建鄉試第五十二名，會試第一百二十四名。

何繼高〔貫浙江紹興府山陰縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝登，行一，年三十五，十月初九日生〕。曾祖詔〔太子少保、工部尚書〕，祖鎬〔官生〕，父景昂〔前府都事〕，母沈氏。永感下。弟繼曾、繼祖〔監生〕、繼魁〔監生〕、士闇〔錦衣衛百戶〕、繼元、繼昭。娶章氏。順天府鄉試第五十一名，會試第三百十二名。
translation_en:
Sun Guangqi 孫光啓 [native of Xiushui County, registered in a commoner household of Jiaxing County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Ziyi; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the second day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Zhang 樟, his grandfather was Sun Ren 仁, his father is Sun Zhidao 志道, and his mother is née Dou 竇氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Sun Shi 詩 [tribute student (gongshi)], and his younger brother is Sun Guangyu 光裕. He married née Xu 徐氏, and subsequently married née Wu 吳氏. He ranked 14th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 236th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rao Shen 饒伸 [registered in a commoner household of Jinxian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyi; third in generational seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Rao Gui 桂, his grandfather is Rao Xun 纁, his father is Rao Ruji 汝楫, and his mother is née Liu 劉氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Rao Tingxi 廷錫 [District Magistrate], Rao Lun 崙 [metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination year], Rao Wei 位 [District Magistrate], Rao Ren 任, Rao Ru 儒, and Rao You 佑; his younger brothers are Rao Chuan 傳, Rao Zhuo 倬, and Rao Fang 倣. He married née Yan 晏氏. He ranked 29th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 120th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Yinglin 蔡應麟 [registered in a commoner household of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zirui; second in generational seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Cai Kuan 寬 [posthumously honored as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Left Vice Minister of Revenue], his grandfather was Cai You 祐 [Prefectural Director of Studies, ennobled as Secretary, and posthumously honored as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Left Vice Minister of Revenue], his father was Cai Kelian 克廉 [Nanjing Minister of Revenue], his legal mother was née Liu 留氏 [repeatedly ennobled as Lady], and his birth mother is née Chen 陳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Cai Xianzong 顯宗 [granted cap and belt by grace], Cai Zhenzong 振宗, Cai Zuanzong 纘宗 [Subprefectural Chief of Police], Cai Maozong 懋宗, and Cai Yinglong 應龍 [official student (guansheng)]; his younger brothers are Cai Yingchen 應辰 and Cai Yingyang 應陽. He married née Yang 楊氏. He ranked 52nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 124th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Jigao 何繼高 [registered in a commoner household of Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rudeng; first in generational seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was He Zhao 詔 [Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of Works], his grandfather was He Hao 鎬 [official student (guansheng)], his father was He Jing'ang 景昂 [Office Manager of the Front Chief Military Commission], and his mother was née Shen 沈氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are He Jizeng 繼曾, He Jizu 繼祖 [Student of the Directorate of Education (jiansheng)], He Jikui 繼魁 [Student of the Directorate of Education (jiansheng)], He Shi'an 士闇 [Company Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard], He Jiyuan 繼元, and He Jizhao 繼昭. He married née Zhang 章氏. He ranked 51st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 312th in the Metropolitan Examination.

方應選〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣，竈籍，國子生。治《書經》，字衆甫，行一，年三十三，四月十九日生〕。曾祖輔；祖鵬；父柱；母王氏。具慶下。弟應遴、應遇。娶曹氏，繼娶胡氏。應天府鄉試第二名，會試第十三名。

申用懋〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣，民籍，國子生。治《書經》，字敬中，行一，年二十四，二月二十五日生〕。曾祖乾〔累贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、戶部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；祖士章〔贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、戶部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；父時行〔光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、戶部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；母吳氏〔累封一品夫人〕。重慶下。弟用嘉〔貢士〕。娶欽氏，繼娶楊氏。順天府鄉試第六名，會試第一百七十二名。

鄒德溥〔貫江西吉安府安福縣，民籍，國子生。治《春秋》，字汝光，行三十，年三十五，七月二十七日生〕。曾祖賢〔按察司僉事，贈奉政大夫〕；祖守益〔中順大夫、南京國子監祭酒，贈禮部右侍郎，謚文莊〕；父善〔布政司右布政〕；母陳氏〔封恭人〕。具慶下。兄德源、德濬、德涵〔按察司僉事〕；弟德溫、德洽、德泳〔貢士〕、德濟、德洙、德澡、德灌、德ต、德洵。娶趙氏。江西鄉試第十一名，會試第二名。

徐即登〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣，民籍，國子生。治《易經》，字獻和，行二，年三十，九月初六日生〕。曾祖律；祖詔〔州吏目〕；父燧〔倉大使〕；母李氏。嚴侍下。弟即用、即元。娶胡氏。江西鄉試第六名，會試第二百三名。
translation_en:
Fang Yingxuan 方應選 [registered in Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, under a salt-producer household (zaoji 竈籍); student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng 國子生); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Zhongfu 衆甫; seniority number first; age thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Fang Fu 輔; his grandfather was Fang Peng 鵬; his father is Fang Zhu 柱; his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Fang Yinglin 應遴 and Fang Yingyu 應遇. He married Lady Cao 曹氏, and subsequently married Lady Hu 胡氏. He placed second in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Yongmao 申用懋 [registered in Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, under a civilian household (minji 民籍); student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng 國子生); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Jingzhong 敬中; seniority number first; age twenty-four, born on the twenty-fifth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Qian 乾 [repeatedly posthumously honored as Grandee of the Thirty-Fifth Class (guanglu dafu 光祿大夫), Supreme Pillar of State (zhuguo 柱國), Junior Guardian (shaobao 少保) concurrently Heir Apparent's Grand Guardian (taizi taibao 太子太保), Minister of Revenue (hubu shangshu 戶部尚書), and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall (Wuying dian daxueshi 武英殿大學士)]; his grandfather was Shen Shizhang 士章 [posthumously honored as Grandee of the Thirty-Fifth Class, Supreme Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Heir Apparent's Grand Guardian, Minister of Revenue, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall]; his father is Shen Shixing 時行 [Grandee of the Thirty-Fifth Class, Supreme Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Heir Apparent's Grand Guardian, Minister of Revenue, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall]; his mother is Lady Wu 吳氏 [repeatedly enfeoffed as Lady of the First Rank (yipin furen 一品夫人)]. Both of his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Shen Yongjia 用嘉 [tribute student / Metropolitan Examination graduate (gongshi 貢士)]. He married Lady Qin 欽氏, and subsequently married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed sixth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zou Depu 鄒德溥 [registered in Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西, under a civilian household (minji 民籍); student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng 國子生); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu 春秋); courtesy name Ruguang 汝光; seniority number thirtieth; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zou Xian 賢 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner (anchasi qianshi 按察司僉事), posthumously honored as Grandee of the Eleventh Class (fengzheng dafu 奉政大夫)]; his grandfather was Zou Shouyi 守益 [Grandee of the Eighth Class (zhongshun dafu 中順大夫), Chancellor of the Nanjing Directorate of Education (Nanjing Guozijian jijiu 南京國子監祭酒), posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of Rites (libu you shilang 禮部右侍郎), posthumously titled Wenzhuang 文莊]; his father is Zou Shan 善 [Right Administration Commissioner (buzhengsi you buzheng 布政司右布政)]; his mother is Lady Chen 陳氏 [enfeoffed as Respectful Lady (gongren 恭人)]. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zou Deyuan 德源, Zou Dejun 德濬, and Zou Dehan 德涵 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner (anchasi qianshi 按察司僉事)]; his younger brothers are Zou Dewen 德溫, Zou Dehia 德洽, Zou Deyong 德泳 [tribute student / Metropolitan Examination graduate (gongshi 貢士)], Zou Deji 德濟, Zou Dezhu 德洙, Zou Dezao 德澡, Zou Deguan 德灌, Zou De-[?] 德ต [?], and Zou Dexun 德洵. He married Lady Zhao 趙氏. He placed eleventh in the Jiangxi 江西 Provincial Examination and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Jideng 徐即登 [registered in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西, under a civilian household (minji 民籍); student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng 國子生); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); courtesy name Xianhe 獻和; seniority number second; age thirty, born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Lü 律; his grandfather was Xu Zhao 詔 [Subprefectural Chief of Jailers / Clerical Supervisor (zhou limu 州吏目)]; his father is Xu Sui 燧 [Granary Commissioner-in-chief (cang dashi 倉大使)]; his mother was Lady Li 李氏. His father is living, while his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Xu Jiyong 即用 and Xu Jiyuan 即元. He married Lady Hu 胡氏. He placed sixth in the Jiangxi 江西 Provincial Examination and two hundred third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Qian Shoucheng 錢守成 (registered in the military officer household category under Henan Guard in Henan, a student of the Henan Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing], courtesy name Kexian 克賢, third in his generation, age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Qian Cong 聰 (Platoon Commander), his grandfather was Qian Fu 府 (Platoon Commander), his father was Qian Guozhen 國珎 (Platoon Commander), and his mother is Madam Deng 鄧氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Qian Shouye 守業 (Platoon Commander) and Qian Shouqing 守慶, and his younger brother is Qian Shouren 守仁. He is married to Madam Zhan 詹氏. He placed twenty-third in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Shisong 王士崧 (registered in the commoner household category of Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, a prefectural school student, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu], courtesy name Zhongshu 中叔, first in his generation, age twenty-nine, born on the nineteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yiqing 逸卿 (posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate), his grandfather was Wang Xun 訓 (posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate), his father is Wang Zongmu 宗沐 (Left Vice Minister of Justice), and his mother is Madam Qin 秦氏 (invested as Mistress of Virtue). Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Shiqi 士琦 (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class), Wang Shichang 士昌 (Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination graduate awaiting the Palace Examination [gongshi]), and Wang Shiye 士業 (student by privilege of official rank [guansheng]). He is married to Madam Su 蘇氏. He placed fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yuan Yingyang 袁應陽 (registered in the commoner household category of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji], courtesy name Daorao 道饒, second in his generation, age thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yuan Hui 惠 (Honorary Official for Longevity), his grandfather was Yuan Guochun 國淳, his father is Yuan Duan 端 (Honorary Official for Longevity), his deceased birth mother was Madam Yang 楊氏, and his stepmother is Madam Li 李氏. His father and stepmother are both living. His elder brother is Yuan Yingchun 應春 (Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination graduate awaiting the Palace Examination [gongshi]), and his younger brothers are Yuan Yiji 一驥 (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class), Yuan Yingchen 應辰, and Yuan Yingjian 應薦. He is married to Madam Li 李氏. He placed fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Zhengyu 郭正域 (registered in the military officer household category under Wuchang Escort Guard in Huguang, a native of Jiangxia County, a county school student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing], courtesy name Meiming 美命, second in his generation, age thirty, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Guo You 佑, his grandfather was Guo Kai 鎧, his father is Guo Mao 懋 (Department Magistrate), his father's former wife was Madam Shang 上氏, and his mother is Madam Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Guo Zhengwei 正位. He is married to Madam Zhang 張氏. He placed eighteenth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yin Du 殷都 (registered as a commoner of Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached region [Zhili]; a Student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Kaimei, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the second day of the first month). Hu Yingchen 胡應辰 (registered in a military household of Daye County, Xingguo Subprefecture, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; a Student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Rugong, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the seventh day of the fifth month). He placed 40th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 97th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Kaizao 李開藻 (registered under a military household in Yongchun County 永春縣, Quanzhou Prefecture 泉州府, Fujian 福建; an added student of the county school; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji 禮記]; courtesy name Qijian 啟鑑; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty, born on the sixteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Li Hanzhong 李漢中; his grandfather was Li Zisheng 李子昇 (Longevity Official); his father is Li Yingchen 李應辰; and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Li Kaifang 李開芳 (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class) and Li Kaifen 李開芬; his younger brother is Li Kaiyun 李開蘊. He is betrothed to a woman née Zhou 周氏. He ranked 58th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 147th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shoupeng 張壽朋 (registered under a commoner household in Nanchang County 南昌縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西, originally from Nancheng County 南城縣, Jianchang Prefecture 建昌府; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Chonghe 冲龢; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Sheng 張昇 (Minister of Rites, posthumously promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness and Grand Tutor concurrently Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Wenxi 文僖); his grandfather was Zhang Zhe 張悊 (Company Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); his father is Zhang Zi 張嵫 (Consort of a Royal Clanswoman); and his mother is the Township Lady of Rongxi (Rongxi xiangjun 榕溪鄉君). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Lin 張林 and Zhang Sen 張森; his younger brothers are Zhang Dapeng 張大朋 and Zhang Baipeng 張百朋. He married a woman née Gao 高氏, and took as his second wife a woman née Hu 胡氏. He ranked 60th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 48th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Shiqi 王士琦 (registered under a commoner household in Linhai County 臨海縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu 春秋]; courtesy name Guishu 圭叔; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yiqing 王逸卿 (posthumously promoted to Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Assistant Censor-in-chief of the Censorate); his grandfather was Wang Xun 王訓 (posthumously promoted to Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Assistant Censor-in-chief of the Censorate); his father is Wang Zongmu 王宗沐 (Left Vice Minister of Justice); and his mother is née Qin 秦氏 (invested as Lady of Virtue). Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Shisong 王士崧 (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class); his younger brothers are Wang Shichang 王士昌 (Tribute Student) and Wang Shiye 王士業 (Official Student). He married a woman née Deng 鄧氏. He ranked 5th in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Zheng 沈烝 (registered under a commoner household in Tongxiang County 桐鄉縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Yinsheng 胤盛; ninth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Lu 沈祿; his grandfather was Shen Ang 沈昂; his father is Shen Pa 沈葩; and his mother is née Qiu 丘氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Shen Mo 沈默 and Shen Xu 沈煦. He married a woman née Wang 王氏. He ranked 34th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 119th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
劉復初〔貫陝西西安府高陵縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字貽哲，行一，年二十七，十一月初七日生〕。曾祖彦成〔贈王府左長史〕；祖遷〔王府左長史，加三品服色〕；父自化〔運使〕；母墨氏〔封宜人〕。重慶下。兄復禮；弟復祖。娶蕭氏，繼娶胡氏。陝西鄉試第一名，會試第五十八名。

白所知〔貫山西澤州陽城縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字廷謨，行二，年二十七，九月十八日生〕。曾祖子富；祖道；父鐸〔監生〕；母馬氏。具慶下。兄所學；弟所行、所蘊、所樂。娶張氏。山西鄉試第一名，會試第一百三十八名。

陳所學〔貫湖廣承天府沔陽州景陵縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《書經》，字正甫，行八，年二十五，十月十五日生〕。曾祖寬；祖守廉；父篆〔恩例冠帶〕；母戴氏。具慶下。兄所著、所選、所前；弟所謨、所答。娶成氏。湖廣鄉試第六十名，會試第一百六名。

王岳錫〔貫錦衣衛旗籍，山東萊州府膠州人，順天府學生，治《詩經》，字子正，行一，年二十五，九月二十五日生〕。曾祖縉〔錦衣衛副千戶〕；祖簡〔贈兵部主事〕；父价〔知府〕；母戴氏〔封安人〕。慈侍下。弟申錫。娶鄭氏。順天府鄉試第六十名，會試第三百四十七名。
translation_en:
Liu Fuchu 劉復初 (registered as a commoner in Gaoling County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a County Student; specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhe; first in seniority among his generation's brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the seventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Yancheng (posthumously bestowed the title of Left Administrator of a Princely Establishment); his grandfather is Liu Qian (Left Administrator of a Princely Establishment, granted the official attire of the third rank); his father is Liu Zihua (Salt Distribution Commissioner); and his mother is Lady Mo (invested as Lady of Suitability). His grandparents and parents are still living. His elder brother is Liu Fuli, and his younger brother is Liu Fuzu. He married Lady Xiao, and after her death married Lady Hu. He placed first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bai Suozhi 白所知 (registered as a commoner in Yangcheng County, Ze Subprefecture, Shanxi; a County Student; specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingmo; second in seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Bai Zifu; his grandfather was Bai Dao; his father is Bai Duo (National University Student); and his mother is Lady Ma. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Bai Suoxue, and his younger brothers are Bai Suoxing, Bai Suoyun, and Bai Suole. He married Lady Zhang. He placed first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Suoxue 陳所學 (registered as a commoner in Jingling County, Mianyang Subprefecture, Chengtian Prefecture, Huguang; a Supernumerary County Student; specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhengfu; eighth in seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Kuan; his grandfather was Chen Shoulian; his father is Chen Zhuan (granted cap and sash by grace regulation); and his mother is Lady Dai. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Suozhu, Chen Suoxuan, and Chen Suoqian, and his younger brothers are Chen Suomo and Chen Suoda. He married Lady Cheng. He placed sixtieth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yuexi 王岳錫 (registered in a banner-bearer household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, originally from Jiao Subprefecture, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; a Prefectural Student of Shuntian Prefecture; specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Zizheng; first in seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Jin (Assistant Battalion Commander in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); his grandfather was Wang Jian (posthumously bestowed the title of Secretary in the Ministry of War); his father was Wang Jie (Prefect); and his mother is Lady Dai (invested as Lady of Peace). His mother is living (his father having passed away). His younger brother is Wang Shenxi. He married Lady Zheng. He placed sixtieth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and three hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

高世芳〔貫河南懷慶府河內縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字德芳，行二，年二十四，十月初六日生〕。曾祖科〔王府引禮舍人〕；祖照〔王府引禮舍人〕；父梧〔縣主簿〕；母何氏，繼母朱氏。重慶下。兄世望，弟世業、世美。娶張氏，繼娶朱氏。河南鄉試第四十三名，會試第二百二名。

陳汝學〔貫四川嘉定州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字仲道，行二，年三十一，二月二十一日生〕。曾祖希賢；祖瑞；父介〔貢士〕；前母阮氏，母宋氏。慈侍下。兄其學，弟問學。娶劉氏。四川鄉試第十三名，會試第二百八十六名。

季東魯〔貫山東濟南府德州德平縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字國望，行一，年二十三，十二月二十一日生〕。曾祖子安；祖効先〔壽官〕；父守業；母劉氏。慈侍下。娶甯氏。山東鄉試第二十一名，會試第三百二十二名。

于玉立〔貫直隸鎮江府金壇縣軍籍，府學生，治《書經》，字中甫，行三，年二十三，五月十六日生〕。曾祖湛〔都察院右副都御史，贈右都御史〕；祖未〔貢士〕；父明照〔貢士〕；母虞氏。具慶下。兄玉鳴、玉聘，弟玉德、玉嘉、玉節、玉奎、玉瑞、玉理。娶曹氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十四名，會試第二百九名。
translation_en:
Gao Shifang 高世芳, registered under a military household in Henei County, Huaiqing Prefecture, Henan, was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Defang, second in his generation, aged twenty-four, born on the sixth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Gao Ke, an Usher in a Princely Establishment; his grandfather was Gao Zhao, an Usher in a Princely Establishment; his father is Gao Wu, a County Assistant Magistrate; his mother was née He, and his stepmother is née Zhu. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Shiwang, and his younger brothers are Shiye and Shimei. He married née Zhang, and subsequently married née Zhu. He placed forty-third in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Ruxue 陳汝學, registered under a civilian household in Jiading Subprefecture, Sichuan, was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), with the courtesy name Zhongdao, second in his generation, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Chen Xixian; his grandfather was Chen Rui; his father was Chen Jie, a Tribute Student; his father's former wife was née Ruan, and his mother is née Song. His mother is living. His elder brother is Qixue, and his younger brother is Wenxue. He married née Liu. He placed thirteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred and eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ji Donglu 季東魯, registered under a civilian household in Deping County, Dezhou Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Guowang, first in his generation, aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Ji Zi'an; his grandfather was Ji Xiaoxian, an Honorary Official for Longevity; his father was Ji Shouye; his mother is née Liu. His mother is living. He married née Ning. He placed twenty-first in the Shandong Provincial Examination and three hundred and twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Yuli 于玉立, registered under a military household in Jintan County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), was a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), with the courtesy name Zhongfu, third in his generation, aged twenty-three, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Yu Zhan, Right Vice Censor-in-chief of the Censorate, posthumously honored as Right Censor-in-chief; his grandfather was Yu Wei, a Tribute Student; his father is Yu Mingzhao, a Tribute Student; his mother is née Yu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yuming and Yuping, and his younger brothers are Yude, Yujia, Yujie, Yukui, Yurui, and Yuli. He married née Cao. He placed one hundred and thirty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and two hundred and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳廉〔貫直隸大名府元城縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字威如，行一，年二十八，三月初二日生〕。曾祖綬〔知府〕；祖鴻雷〔鎮撫〕；父秉忠〔王府審理正〕；母劉氏。具慶下。弟庶、賡、廣。娶張氏，繼娶張氏。順天府鄉試第八十二名，會試第二百八名。

項承芳〔貫浙江嘉興府嘉興縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字達甫，行二，年二十八，八月二十九日生〕。曾祖經〔布政司參政〕；祖鏞〔都指揮使〕；父元涍〔錦衣衛千戶〕；母吳氏〔封宜人〕。具慶下。兄道亨〔監生〕、世芳〔錦衣衛千戶〕、國亨〔監生〕；弟臣亨、時亨〔監生〕、儒亨、復亨、華芳、聯芳、瑞芳。娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第三十二名，會試第一百名。

李民質〔貫直隸大名府東明縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元素，行一，年二十八，二月初七日生〕。曾祖鐸；祖厚；父璇；母簡氏。慈侍下。弟民彝。娶莊氏。順天府鄉試第二十六名，會試第三百三十一名。

translation_en:
Chen Lian 陳廉 (registered in a civilian household of Yuancheng County, Daming Prefecture, Southern or Northern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Weiru; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the second day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Chen Shou 陳綬 (Prefect); his grandfather was Chen Honglei 陳鴻雷 (Judge); his father is Chen Bingzhong 陳秉忠 (Chief Judge of a Princely Establishment); and his mother is Lady Liu 劉氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Chen Shu 陳庶, Chen Geng 陳賡, and Chen Guang 陳廣. He married Lady Zhang 張氏, and took another Lady Zhang 張氏 as his second wife. He placed eighty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiang Chengfang 項承芳 (registered in a civilian household of Jiaxing County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Dafu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Xiang Jing 項經 (Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner); his grandfather was Xiang Yong 項鏞 (Regional Military Commissioner); his father is Xiang Yuanxiao 項元涍 (Battalion Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); and his mother is Lady Wu 吳氏 (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiang Daoheng 項道亨 (National University Student), Xiang Shifang 項世芳 (Battalion Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard), and Xiang Guoheng 項國亨 (National University Student); his younger brothers are Xiang Chenheng 項臣亨, Xiang Shiheng 項時亨 (National University Student), Xiang Ruheng 項儒亨, Xiang Fuheng 項復亨, Xiang Huafang 項華芳, Xiang Lianfang 項聯芳, and Xiang Ruifang 項瑞芳. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed thirty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Minzhi 李民質 (registered in a military household of Dongming County, Daming Prefecture, Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yuansu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the seventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Li Duo 李鐸; his grandfather was Li Hou 李厚; his father was Li Xuan 李璇; and his mother is Lady Jian 簡氏. His mother is living. His younger brother is Li Minyi 李民彝. He married Lady Zhuang 莊氏. He placed twenty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and three hundred and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Dahua 徐大化 (registered in a military household of the Right Forest-of-Plumes Guard, originally from Guiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Supernumerary Student of the Shuntian Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenming; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yuan 徐員; his grandfather was Xu Hao 徐浩; his father is Xu Jie 徐節; and his mother is Lady Liu 劉氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Xu Dashou 徐大綬, and his younger brother is Xu Dashen 徐大伸. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed eighty-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

治易經字世行行三十九年二十五六月二十二日生
曾祖燧〔巡撫江西都察院右副都御史贈禮部尚書諡忠烈加贈榮祿大夫〕 祖陞〔南京禮部尚書贈太子少保諡文恪加贈資政大夫〕 父鑨〔亞中大夫光祿寺卿〕 母錢氏〔累封恭人〕

曾祖欽 祖聞義 父仲綳 母陳氏 繼母徐氏

punctuated:
林國相，貫福建福州府閩縣，軍籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字廷賛，行七，年二十七，十月十九日生。曾祖汝生；祖墰；父謙，母許氏。具慶下。兄一樞、萬機、楊模；弟仕釗〔貢士〕、國棟。娶鄒氏。福建鄉試第八十三名，會試第一百六十二名。

安世鳳，貫直隸歸德衛，軍籍，山西太原府太谷縣人，河南歸德府學生。治《詩經》，字鳳來，行二，年二十六，三月二十四日生。曾祖瑄〔訓導〕；祖思恭〔訓導〕；父所止〔貢士〕，母劉氏。具慶下。兄世禎、世麟；弟世羔、世鶠。娶龔氏。河南鄉試第十二名，會試第十一名。

孫如法，貫錦衣衛，官籍，浙江紹興府餘姚縣人，順天府學附學生。治《易經》，字世行，行三十九，年二十五，六月二十二日生。曾祖燧〔巡撫江西都察院右副都御史，贈禮部尚書，謚忠烈，加贈榮祿大夫〕；祖陞〔南京禮部尚書，贈太子少保，謚文恪，加贈資政大夫〕；父鑨〔亞中大夫、光祿寺卿〕，母錢氏〔累封恭人〕。重慶下。兄如津〔錦衣衛都指揮僉事〕；弟如証、如涇、如洹、如泗。娶史氏。順天府鄉試第十九名，會試第九十五名。

丁繼嗣，貫浙江寧波府鄞縣，竈籍，府學附學生。治《易經》，字國雲，行十三，年二十九，十月二十五日生。曾祖欽；祖聞義；父仲繡，母陳氏，繼母徐氏。慈侍下。兄繼賢、繼誠、繼文〔監生〕、懋建〔知縣〕；弟繼常、懋功、繼祖。娶孫氏，繼娶董氏。浙江鄉試第七十七名，會試第二百四十七名。
translation_en:
Lin Guoxiang 林國相, registered under a military household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, was a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng). He specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), had the courtesy name Tingzan, was seventh in seniority among his male cousins, and was twenty-seven sui, born on the nineteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Lin Rusheng, his grandfather was Lin Tan, his father is Lin Qian, and his mother is née Xu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Lin Yishu, Lin Wanji, and Lin Yangmo [?]; his younger brothers are Lin Shizhao (Tribute Student) and Lin Guodong. He married née Zou. He placed 83rd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 162nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

An Shifeng 安世鳳, registered under a military household in the Guide Guard in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili) and a native of Taigu County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi, was a student of the Guide Prefectural School in Henan. He specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), had the courtesy name Fenglai, was second in seniority, and was twenty-six sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was An Xuan (Assistant Instructor), his grandfather was An Sigong (Assistant Instructor), his father is An Suozhi (Tribute Student), and his mother is née Liu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are An Shizhen and An Shilin; his younger brothers are An Shigao and An Shiyan. He married née Gong. He placed 12th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 11th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Rufa 孫如法, registered under an official household in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei) and a native of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a supernumerary student (fuxuesheng) of the Shuntian Prefectural School. He specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), had the courtesy name Shixing, was thirty-ninth in seniority, and was twenty-five sui, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Sun Sui (Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, posthumously promoted to Minister of Rites, canonized as Zhonglie, and further posthumously promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness); his grandfather was Sun Sheng (Nanjing Minister of Rites, posthumously promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, canonized as Wenke, and further posthumously promoted to Grand Master for Assisting toward Good Governance); his father is Sun Long (Grand Master of the Second Class and Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments), and his mother is née Qian (successively enfeoffed as Respectful Lady). Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Sun Rujin (Assistant Regional Military Commissioner of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); his younger brothers are Sun Ruzheng, Sun Rujing, Sun Ruhuan, and Sun Rusi. He married née Shi. He placed 19th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 95th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Jisi 丁繼嗣, registered under a saltern household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a supernumerary student of the prefectural school. He specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), had the courtesy name Guoyun, was thirteenth in seniority, and was twenty-nine sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Ding Qin, his grandfather was Ding Wenyi, his father was Ding Zhongxiu, his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother is née Xu. His mother (stepmother) is living. His elder brothers are Ding Jixian, Ding Jicheng, Ding Jiwen (Student of the Directorate of Education), and Ding Maojian (District Magistrate); his younger brothers are Ding Jichang, Ding Maogong, and Ding Jizu. He married née Sun, and remarried née Dong. He placed 77th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 247th in the Metropolitan Examination.

張悌〔貫河南南陽府内鄉縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字叔愛，行三，年二十四，正月初九日生〕。曾祖鑑，祖友良〔省祭官〕，父汝楫〔儒官〕，母朱氏。具慶下，兄元愷，弟恂。娶朱氏。河南鄉試第二十六名，會試第三百十八名。

陳一簡〔貫直隸太平府繁昌縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字敬甫，行一，年二十九，九月初九日生〕。曾祖璽〔訓導〕，祖宗堯，父誥〔壽官〕，母嚴氏。具慶下，弟一節、一第、一元。娶方氏。應天府鄉試第九名，會試第四十一名。

郭廷良〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字弼明，行四，年三十四，十一月初八日生〕。曾祖端齊，祖景直，父文榮，母黃氏。永感下，兄廷用〔知縣〕、維禎〔省祭官〕、廷望，弟廷懋、廷舉、廷輔、廷楫、廷璧、廷霖。娶陳氏。福建鄉試第六十四名，會試第二百十四名。

邵庶〔貫直隸徽州府休寧縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字明卿，行三，年二十九，八月初五日生〕。曾祖廷珂，祖天祥，父棠，母汪氏。嚴侍下，兄杰、燕〔貢士〕，弟燾、黙、樵。娶夏氏。應天府鄉試第七十八名，會試第三百二十四名。
translation_en:
Zhang Ti 張悌 [registered as a commoner of Neixiang County, Nanyang Prefecture, Henan; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shu'ai; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Jian; his grandfather was Zhang Youliang [Sacrificial Attendant (shengjiguan)]; his father is Zhang Ruji [Confucian Official (ruguan)]; and his mother is Lady Zhu. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Yuankai, and his younger brother is Xun. He married Lady Zhu. He ranked 26th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 318th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yijian 陳一簡 [registered as a commoner of Fanchang County, Taiping Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Jingfu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the ninth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Xi [Assistant Instructor (xundao)]; his grandfather was Chen Zongyao; his father is Chen Gao [Honorary Official Ranked by Age (shouguan)]; and his mother is Lady Yan. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yijie, Yidi, and Yiyuan. He married Lady Fang. He ranked 9th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 41st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Tingliang 郭廷良 [registered as a commoner of Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Biming; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Guo Duanqi; his grandfather was Guo Jingzhi; his father was Guo Wenrong; and his mother was Lady Huang. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brothers are Tingyong [District Magistrate (zhixian)], Weizhen [Sacrificial Attendant], and Tingwang; his younger brothers are Tingmao, Tingju, Tingfu, Tingji, Tingbi, and Tinglin. He married Lady Chen. He ranked 64th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 214th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shao Shu 邵庶 [registered as a commoner of Xiuning County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Mingqing; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Shao Tingke; his grandfather was Shao Tianxiang; his father is Shao Tang; and his mother was Lady Wang. His father is living and his mother is deceased (yanshi xia). His elder brothers are Jie and Yan [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his younger brothers are Tao, Mo, and Qiao. He married Lady Xia. He ranked 78th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 324th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Qi 王祺 (registered under civilian household status in Kaizhou, Daming Prefecture, Southern Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhaoji; first in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Wei; his grandfather was Wang Chongxian (Directorate Student); his father was Wang Yuequan; his mother was née Bian, and his stepmothers were née Zhou and née Shi. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Wang Zhen, Wang Zuo (Tribute Student), and Wang Zhen. He married née Luo, and subsequently married née Zhang. He placed 62nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 320th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhan Zaipan 詹在泮 (registered under civilian household status in Changshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a county student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals; courtesy name Xiangong; sixth in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhan Si (Honorary Official); his grandfather was Zhan Lie (Annual Tribute Student); his father was Zhan Lai (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner); his father's former wife was née Xu, and his mother is née Wu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhan Xiance (Tribute Student), Zhan Siyu (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), Zhan Zaijing, and Zhan Siqian (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his younger brothers are Zhan Zaihao, Zhan Zaizao, Zhan Zaizhi, Zhan Zaiting, Zhan Zaiyin, Zhan Zaibang, Zhan Zaichao, and Zhan Zaiting. He married née Xu. He placed 36th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 198th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Li 何鯉 (registered under civilian household status in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bolong; fourth in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was He Xiao; his grandfather was He Wei; his father was He Tong; his mother was née Zhang, and his stepmother was née Wang. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brothers are He [?] (𱸣), He Lu, and He Lian; his younger brother is He Fang. He married née Pan, and subsequently married née Li. He placed 20th in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and 80th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Xin 楊信 (registered under civilian household status in Xianning County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; an added student of the county school (xianxue zengguangsheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yicheng; fifth in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the first day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Zhong; his grandfather was Yang Hui; his father was Yang Feng; his mother was née Ji. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yang Ren, Yang Yi, Yang Li, and Yang Zhi; his younger brothers are Yang Guan, Yang [?] (𪝠), Yang Jian, and Yang Cui. He married née Xu, and subsequently married née Han. He placed 13th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 238th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Duqing 胡篤卿 (native of Daping [Taiping] County, Ningguo Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili], of commoner registration, a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing], courtesy name Yongguang, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twentieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Hu Xian 獻; his grandfather was Hu Mei 鎂; his father is Hu Quan 淃, and his mother is née Li 李氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Liangqing 亮卿, Wenqing 文卿, and Huaqing 華卿. He married née Li 李氏, and later married née Tang 湯氏. He placed sixty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Kaifang 李開芳 (native of Yongchun County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of military registration, a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing], courtesy name Qidong, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Li Hanzhong 漢中; his grandfather is Li Zisheng 子昇 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father is Li Yingyuan 應元 (Annual Tribute Student), and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Kaifen 開芬, Kaizao 開藻 (a metropolitan graduate [jinshi] of the same examination class), and Kaiyun 開蘊. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed sixteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Yong 蕭雍 (native of Jing County, Ningguo Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili], of commoner registration, a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing], courtesy name Sixian, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Shigui 士貴 (posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Xiao Rui 瑞 (Right Assistant Administration Commissioner); his father was Xiao Chu 儲 (successively posthumously granted the title of Chief Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue), and his mother was née Dong 董氏 (invested as Dowager Child-Nurturer and posthumously granted the title of Child-Nurturer). Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Bao 褒 (Assistant County Magistrate), Xin 歆 (Directorate Student), Hao 豪, and Yan 彥 (Chief Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue); his younger brothers are Shao 韶, Yan 顏 (Directorate Student), and Hu 護. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed eighty-first in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yaofeng 王堯封 (native of Jintan County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili], of commoner registration, a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Erzhu, twelfth in seniority among brothers, aged forty-one, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Han 瀚 (posthumously granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of War); his grandfather was Wang Gai 槩 (Directorate Student); his father was Wang Weixiong 維熊 (Government Student with honorary cap and belt), and his mother is née Ge 葛氏. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brothers are Sidao 思道 (Directorate Student), Sixiao 思孝 (did not serve in office; both granted honorary cap and belt [?]), Sigong 思貢, Sizhong 思忠 (Directorate Student), Xian 憲 (Tribute Student), Cong 聰 (Tribute Student), Liangchen 良臣 (Directorate Student), Dayou 大有, Dasheng 大生 (Directorate Student), and Dakuang 大匡 (Tribute Student); his younger brothers [transcription repeats 弟] are Dakai 大開 and Bangda 邦達. He married née Yu 于氏, and later married née Xu 許氏. He placed twelfth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

莊履朋〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣鹽籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字中益，行二，年三十二，二月十七日生〕。曾祖旺〔封吏部員外郎〕；祖一俊〔布政司左參議〕；父望槐〔封翰林院編脩〕；母丘氏〔贈孺人〕；繼母褚氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下。兄履豐〔翰林院編脩〕；弟履隆、履源、履萬、履丙。娶李氏。福建鄉試第五十六名，會試第一百八十九名。

虞淳熙〔貫浙江杭州右衛軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字澹然，行一，年三十一，閏三月十六日生〕。曾祖奎；祖翊；父舜卿；母黃氏。嚴侍下。弟淳貞、淳粹、淳潔、淳全、淳完、淳至、淳簡、淳化。娶楊氏，繼娶李氏。浙江鄉試第四名，會試第二十七名。

盧夢錫〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣民籍，浙江紹興府餘姚縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字國禎，行一，年三十一，十二月二十一日生〕。曾祖達〔府同知〕；祖浩〔壽官〕；父汝柟；母陳氏。慈侍下。弟載錫、永錫、申錫。娶楊氏。順天府鄉試第十三名，會試第四十四名。

劉應同〔貫湖廣承天府潜江縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字春卿，行二，年二十九，二月二十五日生〕。曾祖恒謙；祖第；父爾順〔恩例冠帶〕；母郭氏。嚴侍下。兄應履、應泰；弟應寀、應奎、應舉、應時、應鈳、應鎬。娶戴氏。湖廣鄉試第三十一名，會試第四十名。
translation_en:
Zhuang Lüpeng 莊履朋 [registered in a salter household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zhongyi 中益; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhuang Wang 旺 [invested as Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel]; his grandfather was Zhuang Yijun 一俊 [Left Assistant Administration Commissioner]; his father is Zhuang Wanghuai 望槐 [invested as Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy]; his mother was née Qiu 丘 [posthumously honored as Child Nurturess (ruren)]; and his stepmother is née Chu 褚 [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Zhuang Lüfeng 履豐 [Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy]; his younger brothers are Zhuang Lülong 履隆, Zhuang Lüyuan 履源, Zhuang Lüwan 履萬, and Zhuang Lübing 履丙. He married née Li 李. He placed 56th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 189th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Chunxi 虞淳熙 [registered in a military household in the Hangzhou Right Guard, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Danran 澹然; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the intercalary third month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Kui 奎; his grandfather was Yu Yi 翊; his father is Yu Shunqing 舜卿; and his mother was née Huang 黃. His father is living. His younger brothers are Yu Chunzhen 淳貞, Yu Chuncui 淳粹, Yu Chunjie 淳潔, Yu Chunquan 淳全, Yu Chunwan 淳完, Yu Chunzhi 淳至, Yu Chunjian 淳簡, and Yu Chunhua 淳化. He married née Yang 楊, and remarried née Li 李. He placed 4th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 27th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Mengxi 盧夢錫 [registered in a civilian household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), originally from Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Guozhen 國禎; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Da 達 [Prefectural Vice Prefect]; his grandfather was Lu Hao 浩 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his father was Lu Runan 汝柟; and his mother is née Chen 陳. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Lu Zaixi 載錫, Lu Yongxi 永錫, and Lu Shenxi 申錫. He married née Yang 楊. He placed 13th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 44th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yingtong 劉應同 [registered in a civilian household in Qianjiang County, Chengtian Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Chunqing 春卿; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Hengqian 恒謙; his grandfather was Liu Di 第; his father is Liu Ershun 爾順 [granted official cap and belt by special grace]; and his mother was née Guo 郭. His father is living. His elder brothers are Liu Yinglü 應履 and Liu Yingtai 應泰; his younger brothers are Liu Yingcai 應寀, Liu Yingkui 應奎, Liu Yingju 應舉, Liu Yingshi 應時, Liu Yingke 應鈳, and Liu Yinghao 應鎬. He married née Dai 戴. He placed 31st in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 40th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
第三甲二百七十一名。賜同進士出身。

楊元祥〔貫錦衣衛官籍，山西平陽府蒲州人，順天府學附學生，治《易經》，字日泰，行一，年十九，三月十三日生〕。曾祖瞻〔僉事，封兵部左侍郎，贈光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書〕；祖博〔光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書，贈太傅，謚襄毅，追贈特進〕；父俊卿〔錦衣衛都指揮僉事〕；母王氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下。兄元禎；弟元祉、元禧、元祺、元祜、元裕、元禨、元禔。聘張氏，娶羅氏。順天府鄉試第九十二名，會試第五十三名。

龔雲致〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣鹽籍，府學附學生，治《易經》，字迪潤，行二，年三十，六月十一日生〕。曾祖永；祖裕；父時應〔貢士〕；母陳氏，繼母張氏。永感下。兄雲會、廷賓〔同科進士〕；弟雲耀、雲敷、雲敫。娶蕭氏。福建鄉試第十五名，會試第一百三十五名。

章尚學〔貫浙江金華府蘭谿縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字宗理，行六十九，年三十四，六月十六日生〕。曾祖揇；祖討；父術；母應氏。永感下。兄尚廉；弟尚和、尚敬。娶吳氏，繼娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百十名。
translation_en:
Third Class, 271 candidates. Conferred the status of Fellow of the Jinshi Degree (tong jinshi chushen).

Yang Yuanxiang 楊元祥 (registered under an official household in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, originally from Puzhou in Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; an Added Student of the Shuntian Prefectural School; specialized in the Book of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Ritai 日泰; seniority number 1; age 19, born on the 13th day of the 3rd month). His great-grandfather was Yang Zhan 楊瞻 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, enfeoffed as Left Vice Minister of War, posthumously promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Personnel); his grandfather was Yang Bo 楊博 (Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Personnel, posthumously promoted to Grand Tutor, canonized as Xiangyi 襄毅, and further posthumously promoted to Specially Advanced); his father is Yang Junqing 楊俊卿 (Assistant Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏 (titled Lady of Virtue). Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yuanzhen 元禎, and his younger brothers are Yuanzhi 元祉, Yuanxi 元禧, Yuanqi 元祺, Yuanhu 元祜, Yuanyu 元裕, Yuanji 元禨, and Yuanti 元禔. He was betrothed to Lady Zhang 張氏 and married Lady Luo 羅氏. He placed 92nd in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 53rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gong Yunzhi 龔雲致 (registered under a salt-producer household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; an Added Student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Book of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Dirun 迪潤; seniority number 2; age 30, born on the 11th day of the 6th month). His great-grandfather was Gong Yong 龔永; his grandfather was Gong Yu 龔裕; his father was Gong Shiying 龔時應 (Tribute Student); his mother was Lady Chen 陳氏, and his stepmother was Lady Zhang 張氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yunhui 雲會 and Tingbin 廷賓 (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class), and his younger brothers are Yunyao 雲耀, Yunfu 雲敷, and Yunjiao 雲敫. He married Lady Xiao 蕭氏. He placed 15th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 135th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shangxue 章尚學 (registered under a civilian household in Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zongli 宗理; seniority number 69; age 34, born on the 16th day of the 6th month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Nan 章揇; his grandfather was Zhang Tao 章討; his father was Zhang Shu 章術; and his mother was Lady Ying 應氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Shanglian 尚廉, and his younger brothers are Shanghe 尚和 and Shangjing 尚敬. He married Lady Wu 吳氏, and later married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed 25th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 110th in the Metropolitan Examination.

陸起龍〔貫直隸蘇州府太倉州民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字震卿，行四，年三十，正月初十日生〕。曾祖貫；祖莊；父文明；母武氏。嚴侍下。弟起鳳。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第四名，會試第二百五十八名。

translation_en:
An Wenbi 安文璧: Registered in a civilian household of Anyang County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan, he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Zhongshu, second in his generation, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was An Hong (Office Manager of a Provincial Administration Commission), his grandfather was An Zhong, his father is An Rubang (Confucian Official), and his mother is née Liang. Both parents are living. His elder brother is WenKui, and his younger brother is Wendou; he married a woman née Shen. He placed 6th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 325th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Liangchen 沈良臣: Registered in a military household of Guiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, he was a supernumerary student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Yunzhong, first in his generation, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Shen Rizhang (Confucian Official), his grandfather was Shen Hao, his father was Shen Guanhai, and his mother is née Lu. His mother is living (father deceased). His younger brothers are Liangqing, Liangbi, Liangru, Liangshi, Liangxiang, Liangfu, Liangke, and Cunde; he married a woman née Sima. He placed 52nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 260th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Qilong 陸起龍: Registered in a civilian household of Taicang Subprefecture, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), he was a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), with the courtesy name Zhenqing, fourth in his generation, aged thirty, born on the tenth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Lu Guan, his grandfather was Lu Zhuang, his father is Lu Wenming, and his mother was née Wu. His father is living (mother deceased). His younger brother is Qifeng; he married a woman née Wang. He placed 4th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 258th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Xun 楊恂: Registered in a military household of Zhenwu Guard, Shanxi, he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), with the courtesy name Yichun, first in his generation, aged twenty-seven, born on the fourth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Yang Neng, his grandfather is Yang Xiao, his father is Yang Jimei (Honorary Official for Longevity), and his mother is née Guo. Both parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Heng; he married a woman née Xue. He placed 51st in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 330th in the Metropolitan Examination.

曹楷〔貫山東東昌府臨清州民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字正夫，行三，年二十八，五月二十八日生〕。曾祖文厚；祖璋；父大瀾〔監生〕。前母姚氏；母汪氏。慈侍下。兄橋；弟朴、柱、標。娶李氏。山東鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百六十三名。

方萬策〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字元忠，行二，年二十七，四月十九日生〕。曾祖熊〔監生〕；祖子春；父鏊。前母陳氏；母彭氏。慈侍下。兄鯤〔貢士〕、萬有〔工科給事中〕、山岳〔聽選官〕、繼曾〔貢士〕、萬育；弟萬仞。娶李氏，繼娶陳氏、陳氏。福建鄉試第八十二名，會試第二百七十二名。

唐一鵬〔貫貴州平溪衛官籍，湖廣蘄州人，衛學生，治《詩經》，字九萬，行二，年二十六，四月初一日生〕。曾祖輔；祖臣〔千戶〕；父宗堯〔教諭〕。母洪氏；繼母袁氏。具慶下。兄一龍〔千戶〕；弟一麟、一鯨、一魁。娶田氏。貴州鄉試第十三名，會試第三百二十八名。

方懋學〔貫福建福州府福清縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字壯行，行三，年二十五，八月初十日生〕。曾祖垣；祖文佑；父鏜。母魏氏。具慶下。弟懋言、懋功、懋本。娶王氏。福建鄉試第五十名，會試第一百七十一名。
translation_en:
Cao Kai 曹楷 [registered in a commoner household in Linqing Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; Student in a Prefectural School; specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhengfu; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Cao Wenhou; his grandfather was Cao Zhang; and his father was Cao Dalan [Student of the Directorate of Education]. His father's former wife was née Yao, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. His elder brother is Cao Qiao; his younger brothers are Cao Pu, Cao Zhu, and Cao Biao. He married née Li. He placed 25th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 163rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Wance 方萬策 [registered in a commoner household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Student in a County School; specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yuanzhong; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Fang Xiong [Student of the Directorate of Education]; his grandfather was Fang Zichun; and his father was Fang Ao. His father's former wife was née Chen, and his mother is née Peng. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Fang Kun [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Fang Wanyou [Supervising Secretary for the Office of Scrutiny for Works], Fang Shanyue [Official Awaiting Appointment], Fang Jizeng [Tribute Student (gongshi)], and Fang Wanyu; his younger brother is Fang Wanren. He married née Li, and subsequently married née Chen and née Chen. He placed 82nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 272nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Yipeng 唐一鵬 [registered in an hereditary military officer household in the Pingxi Guard, Guizhou, originally from Qizhou, Huguang; Student in a Guard School; specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Jiuwan; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six, born on the first day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Tang Fu; his grandfather was Tang Chen [Battalion Commander]; and his father is Tang Zongyao [Instructor]. His mother was née Hong, and his stepmother is née Yuan. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His elder brother is Tang Yilong [Battalion Commander]; his younger brothers are Tang Yilin, Tang Yijing, and Tang Yikui. He married née Tian. He placed 13th in the Guizhou Provincial Examination and 328th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Maoxue 方懋學 [registered in a commoner household in Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Zhuangxing; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-five, born on the tenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Fang Yuan; his grandfather was Fang Wenyu; and his father is Fang Tang. His mother is née Wei. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Fang Maoyan, Fang Maogong, and Fang Maoben. He married née Wang. He placed 50th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 171st in the Metropolitan Examination.
