俞咨禹〔貫福建鎮海衛銅山所軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字司平，行一，年三十二，十二月十四日生〕。曾祖慈保；祖世縝；父瑤，母黃氏。永感下。弟咨伯。娶劉氏，繼娶徐氏。福建鄉試第三十六名，會試第一百九十七名。

潘士藻〔貫直隸徽州府婺源縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字去華，行二，年三十四，八月二十五日生〕。曾祖祥；祖鉞；父𣶬，母詹氏。慈侍下。兄士崇，弟士來。娶汪氏。應天府鄉試第三十一名，會試第一百九名。

聞金和〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字韶初，行三，年三十四，四月十八日生〕。曾祖銘；祖瑞；父詩，母張氏，繼母李氏。慈侍下。兄金聲、玉振，弟玉節、金章、玉策。娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第二十九名，會試第二百七名。

李獻可〔貫福建泉州府同安縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字堯俞，行一，年三十一，九月初三日生〕。曾祖瑄；祖回；父霖慰，前母楊氏，母林氏，繼母林氏。慈侍下。弟時可、繼可、試可、弼可。娶吳氏。福建鄉試第二十五名，會試第三十六名。
translation_en:
Yu Ziyu 俞咨禹 (registered under a military household of Tongshan Battalion in Zhenhai Guard, Fujian; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Siping 司平; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Cibao 慈保; his grandfather was Yu Shizhen 世縝; his father was Yu Yao 瑤, and his mother was Lady Huang 黃氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Yu Zibo 咨伯. He married Lady Liu 劉氏, and took Lady Xu 徐氏 as his繼娶 (second wife). He placed thirty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Shizao 潘士藻 (registered under a civilian household of Wuyuan County in Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Quhua 去華; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Pan Xiang 祥; his grandfather was Pan Yue 鉞; his father was Pan Zhu 𣶬, and his mother was Lady Zhan 詹氏. His mother is living (while his father is deceased). His elder brother is Pan Shichong 士崇, and his younger brother is Pan Shilai 士來. He married Lady Wang 汪氏. He placed thirty-first in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wen Jinhe 聞金和 (registered under a civilian household of Yuyao County in Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shaochu 韶初; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eighteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wen Ming 銘; his grandfather was Wen Rui 瑞; his father was Wen Shi 詩, his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏, and his stepmother was Lady Li 李氏. His stepmother is living (while his father is deceased). His elder brothers are Wen Jinsheng 金聲 and Wen Yuzhen 玉振, and his younger brothers are Wen Yujie 玉節, Wen Jinzhang 金章, and Wen Yuce 玉策. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed twenty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Xianke 李獻可 (registered under a civilian household of Tong'an County in Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Yaoyu 堯俞; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the third day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Li Xuan 瑄; his grandfather was Li Hui 回; his father was Li Linwei 霖慰, his father's former wife was Lady Yang 楊氏, his mother was Lady Lin 林氏, and his stepmother was Lady Lin 林氏. His stepmother is living (while his father is deceased). His younger brothers are Li Shike 時可, Li Jike 繼可, Li Shike 試可, and Li Bike 弼可. He married Lady Wu 吳氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

周九臯〔貫河南開封府杞縣民籍，浙江金華府永康縣人，杞縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字翀明，行三，年二十六，二月初五日生〕。曾祖鑑；祖晁；父濙〔太醫醫院冠帶醫士〕；前母吳氏；母劉氏、鄭氏；生母張氏。慈侍下。兄廷梅、廷權、九成、九德；弟九逵、九經、九思。娶孫氏。河南鄉試第一名，會試第一百三十四名。

Chen Rubi 陳汝璧 [registered in a civilian household of Mianyang Department, Chengtian Prefecture, Huguang; a Department Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Lifu; fourth in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-six; born on the nineteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Pan [posthumously granted the prestige title of Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and the office of Secretary in the Ministry of War]; his grandfather was Chen Bai [Surveillance Vice Commissioner, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master for Discussion]; his father is Chen Wenzhu [Administration Vice Commissioner]; his mother is Lady Tong [invested as Respectful Lady]. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Rukan, Chen Rusheng [National University Student], and Chen Rujia; his younger brothers are Chen Rugui [National University Student] and Chen Ruyao. He married Lady Zhang. He placed 53rd in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 86th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Jiugao 周九臯 [registered in a civilian household of Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; originally from Yongkang County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Supplementary Student in the Qi County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chongming; third in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-six; born on the fifth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Jian; his grandfather was Zhou Chao; his father was Zhou Ying [Cap-and-Belt Medical Practitioner in the Imperial Academy of Medicine]; his father's former wife was Lady Wu; his mothers are Lady Liu and Lady Zheng; his birth mother is Lady Zhang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhou Tingmei, Zhou Tingquan, Zhou Jiucheng, and Zhou Jiude; his younger brothers are Zhou Jiukui, Zhou Jiujing, and Zhou Jiusi. He married Lady Sun. He placed 1st in the Henan Provincial Examination and 134th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ji Daotong 季道統 [registered in an official household of Chenzhou Guard, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a Department Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yiqing; first in seniority in his line; age twenty-eight; born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Ji Wei; his grandfather was Ji Ze; his father is Ji Zan; his mother is Lady Ruan. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Ji Yingpin; his younger brothers are Ji Zhitong, Ji Santong, Ji Qian, Ji Kun, Ji Fangtong, and Ji Runtong. He married Lady Kong. He placed 29th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 245th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Wanren 徐萬仞 [registered in a civilian household of Pucheng County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhi; second in seniority in his line; age thirty-three; born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Can; his grandfather was Xu Xuan; his father was Xu Ti; his mother was Lady Ye. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Xu Lan, Xu Zhi, Xu Xun, Xu Hui, Xu Yun, Xu Cang, Xu Tai, Xu Peng, and Xu Tu; his younger brothers are Xu Lai, Xu Ai, and Xu Xiang. He married Lady Yang. He placed 91st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 192nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
葉修〔貫江西南昌府南昌縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字克慎，行四，年三十一，八月初八日生〕。曾祖景發；祖時蓋〔封文林郎、推官〕；父照〔南京禮部郎中〕；母辜氏〔封孺人〕。永感下。兄任。娶李氏。江西鄉試第七十一名，會試第三十一名。

張守乾〔貫河南衛輝府輝縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字汝健，行一，年三十五，十月二十九日生〕。曾祖茂；祖椿；父麒；母顧氏，繼母吉氏。慈侍下。弟守坤、守巽、守震、守泰、守恒。娶趙氏，繼娶宋氏，再娶楊氏。河南鄉試第三十二名，會試第三百四十二名。

崔景榮〔貫直隸大名府長垣縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字自強，行三，年二十七，四月十一日生〕。曾祖表；祖粟；父聞禮；母劉氏。具慶下。兄景福、景祿；弟景星。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第六十一名，會試第二百七十三名。

呂胤昌〔貫錦衣衛官籍，浙江紹興府餘姚縣人，順天府學生，治《禮記》，字王繩，行四，年二十四，五月初四日生〕。曾祖改〔贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太傅、禮部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；祖本〔光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太傅、禮部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；父兌〔禮部主事〕；母孫氏。重慶下。弟胤禎、胤基、胤昇、胤祥、胤高、胤英、胤昂、胤芳、胤隆、胤僖、胤良、胤恭、胤震、胤祖、胤礽。娶潘氏。順天府鄉試第四十三名，會試第一百十八名。
translation_en:
Ye Xiu 葉修 (registered under a military household in Nanchang County 南昌縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Keshen 克慎; fourth in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the eighth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Ye Jingfa 葉景發; his grandfather was Ye Shigai 葉時蓋 (invested as Gentleman-litterateur and Prefectural Judge); his father was Ye Zhao 葉照 (Bureau Director in the Nanjing Ministry of Rites); and his mother was née Gu 辜氏 (invested as Child Nurturer). Both his parents are deceased. He has an elder brother, Ye Ren 葉任, and is married to née Li 李氏. He ranked 71st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 31st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shouqian 張守乾 (registered under a civilian household in Hui County 輝縣, Weihui Prefecture 衛輝府, Henan 河南; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Rujian 汝健; first in seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Mao 張茂; his grandfather was Zhang Chun 張椿; his father was Zhang Qi 張麒; his mother was née Gu 顧氏, and his stepmother is née Ji 吉氏. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Zhang Shoukun 張守坤, Zhang Shouxun 張守巽, Zhang Shouzhen 張守震, Zhang Shoutai 張守泰, and Zhang Shouheng 張守恒. He married née Zhao 趙氏, took née Song 宋氏 as a second wife, and married a third time to née Yang 楊氏. He ranked 32nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 342nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cui Jingrong 崔景榮 (registered under a civilian household in Changyuan County 長垣縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili 直隸; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Ziqiang 自強; third in seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Cui Biao 崔表; his grandfather was Cui Su 崔粟; his father is Cui Wenli 崔聞禮; and his mother is née Liu 劉氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Cui Jingfu 崔景福 and Cui Jinglu 崔景祿; his younger brother is Cui Jingxing 崔景星. He is married to née Wang 王氏. He ranked 61st in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 273rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Yinchang 呂胤昌 (registered under an official household in the Embroidered-uniform Guard [Jinyiwei], native of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; Student of the Shuntian Prefectural School; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Wangsheng 王繩 [?]; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-four, born on the fourth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Lü Gai 呂改 (posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Rites, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall); his grandfather is Lü Ben 呂本 (Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Rites, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall); his father is Lü Dui 呂兌 (Secretary in the Ministry of Rites); and his mother is née Sun 孫氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Lü Yinzhen 呂胤禎, Lü Yinji 呂胤基, Lü Yinsheng 呂胤昇, Lü Yinxiang 呂胤祥, Lü Yingao 呂胤高, Lü Yinying 呂胤英, Lü Yin'ang 呂胤昂, Lü Yinfang 呂胤芳, Lü Yinlong 呂胤隆, Lü Yinxi 呂胤僖, Lü Yinliang 呂胤良, Lü Yingong 呂胤恭, Lü Yinzhen 呂胤震, Lü Yinzu 呂胤祖, and Lü Yinreng 呂胤礽. He is married to née Pan 潘氏. He ranked 43rd in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 118th in the Metropolitan Examination.

王時濟〔貫山西平陽府絳州稷山縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字道甫，行二，年三十九，十月初一日生〕。曾祖興；祖滿；父越，前母段氏、史氏，母朱氏。慈侍下。兄時政。娶任氏，繼娶梁氏。山西鄉試第十九名，會試第七十五名。

吳堯臣〔貫直隸徽州府休寧縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字師錫，行二，年三十四，十一月初三日生〕。曾祖若凰；祖孟賢；父瓊，前母畢氏，母畢氏。慈侍下。兄堯時，弟堯年。娶孫氏。應天府鄉試第二十九名，會試第一百五十一名。

translation_en:
Wang Shiji 王時濟 (registered as a civilian household in Jishan County, Jiang Department, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Daofu 道甫; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-nine, born on the first day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Xing 興; his grandfather was Wang Man 滿; his father was Wang Yue 越, his father's former wives were Lady Duan 段氏 and Lady Shi 史氏, and his mother is Lady Zhu 朱氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Wang Shizheng 時政. He married Lady Ren 任氏, and remarried Lady Liang 梁氏. He ranked nineteenth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Yaochen 吳堯臣 (registered as a military household in Xiuning County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shixi 師錫; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wu Ruohuang 若凰; his grandfather was Wu Mengxian 孟賢; his father was Wu Qiong 瓊, his father's former wife was Lady Bi 畢氏, and his mother is Lady Bi 畢氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Wu Yaoshi 堯時, and his younger brother is Wu Yaonian 堯年. He married Lady Sun 孫氏. He ranked twenty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Deliang 程德良 (registered as an official household in Yunmeng County, De'an Prefecture, Huguang; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ningzhi 凝之; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the fourteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Cheng Sheng 升 (Annual Tribute Student, posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Cheng Chunlin 春霖; his father is Cheng Zao 造 (Honorary Official for Longevity), and his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Cheng Yisi 一駟 and Cheng Yilu 一騄. He married Lady Zhao 趙氏. He ranked sixty-ninth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Zhe 任悊 (registered as a military household in Nanchong County, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Siming 四明; sixth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Ren Xiao 傚; his grandfather was Ren Zuan 纘 (District Magistrate); his father was Ren Liang 良 (Assistant Administration Commissioner), his father's former wife was Lady Cheng 程氏 (posthumously granted the title of Child Nurturer), and his mother was Lady Ma 馬氏 (invested as Child Nurturer). Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Ren Guangzu 光祖, Ren Shu 恕, and Ren Si 思 (Registrar of a Salt Distribution Commission), and his younger brothers are Ren De 惪, Ren Yu 愚 (Tribute Student), and Ren De 惪 [?]. He married Lady Feng 馮氏. He ranked twenty-eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳繼疇〔貫浙江紹興府上虞縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字師洛，行二，年二十八，九月初二日生〕。曾祖璉；祖鈇；父旦；母褚氏。具慶下。娶黃氏。浙江鄉試第八十五名，會試第一百七十六名。

馬猶龍〔貫河南汝寧府光州固始縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字長平，行一，年二十六，七月初四日生〕。曾祖濬；祖瑞〔壽官〕；父壽高〔壽官〕；嫡母陳氏；生母羅氏。具慶下。弟亦龍。娶宋氏，繼娶王氏。河南鄉試第九名，會試第二百九十八名。

王道顯〔貫福建泉州府同安縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字當世，行二，年三十，六月十三日生〕。曾祖岑；祖濟〔歲貢生，封南京戶部主事〕；父三錫；母蔡氏。重慶下。兄道熙；弟道蒸、道照、道默、道煦、道謙、道燫、道烋。娶黃氏。福建鄉試第七十八名，會試第二百二十六名。

錢一本〔貫直隸常州府武進縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字國端，行一，年三十一，八月十三日生〕。曾祖銓〔壽官〕；祖稔；父繪；母陳氏。具慶下。兄一元；弟一亮、一貞、一明。娶曹氏。應天府鄉試第三十九名，會試第一百五十四名。
translation_en:
Chen Jichou 陳繼疇 [registered as a commoner in Shangyu County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Shiluo; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Lian 璉; his grandfather was Chen Fu 鈇; his father is Chen Dan 旦; his mother is née Chu 褚氏. Both parents are living. He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed 85th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 176th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Youlong 馬猶龍 [registered as a commoner in Gushi County, Guangzhou, Runing Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Changping; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six; born on the fourth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Jun 濬; his grandfather was Ma Rui 瑞 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his father is Ma Shougao 壽高 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his legal mother is née Chen 陳氏; his birth mother is née Luo 羅氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Ma Yilong 亦龍. He married née Song 宋氏, and subsequently married née Wang 王氏. He placed 9th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 298th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Daoxian 王道顯 [registered in a military household in Tong'an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Dangshi; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty; born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Cen 岑; his grandfather is Wang Ji 濟 [Annual Tribute Student, invested as Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue]; his father is Wang Sanxi 三錫; his mother is née Cai 蔡氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Wang Daoxi 道熙; his younger brothers are Wang Daozheng 道蒸, Wang Daozhao 道照, Wang Daomo 道默, Wang Daoxu 道煦, Wang Daoqian 道謙, Wang Daolan 道燫, and Wang Daoxiu 道烋. He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed 78th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 226th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Yiben 錢一本 [registered as a commoner in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Guoduan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one; born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Qian Quan 銓 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his grandfather was Qian Ren 稔; his father is Qian Hui 繪; his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Qian Yiyuan 一元; his younger brothers are Qian Yiliang 一亮, Qian Yizhen 一貞, and Qian Yiming 一明. He married née Cao 曹氏. He placed 39th in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and 154th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
于若瀛〔貫山東濟寧衛軍籍，登州府萊陽縣人，濟寧州學生，治《易經》，字子步，行二，年二十九，十一月二十七日生〕。曾祖龍〔壽官〕；祖賢〔封戶部主事〕；父錦〔布政司左布政〕；母謝氏〔封安人〕。慈侍下。兄若汶、若沂、若洙、若滈、若濟、若濱、若澄；弟若淇。娶張氏，繼娶王氏。山東鄉試第二名，會試第一百三十一名。
陳其志〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字公衡，行二，年二十八，九月初九日生〕。曾祖伯獻〔中憲大夫、按察司提學副使〕；祖大沛；父應樅；前母鄭氏；母林氏。具慶下。娶林氏。福建鄉試第十四名，會試第一百五十名。
周之基〔貫湖廣長沙府湘潭縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字季卿，行四，年三十一，八月初五日生〕。曾祖淦；祖思時；父訓〔歲貢生，累封南京吏部郎中〕；母楊氏〔累封宜人〕。嚴侍下。兄之屏〔按察司按察使〕、之翰〔知縣〕、之光〔歲貢生〕；弟之命、之龍。娶羅氏，繼娶許氏。湖廣鄉試第十一名，會試第一百八十二名。
徐榜〔貫直隸寧國府涇縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字賢甫，行四，年三十三，六月二十一日生〕。曾祖來；祖吉；父沐〔府經歷〕；母董氏。重慶下。兄材、枋、權；弟梁。娶董氏。順天府鄉試第九名，會試第二百四十六名。
translation_en:
Yu Ruoying 于若瀛 [registered in a military household of Jining Guard in Shandong, originally from Laiyang County in Dengzhou Prefecture; a student of the Jining Subprefectural School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zibu, second in generational order, age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Long [Honorary Official for Advanced Age]; his grandfather was Yu Xian [invested with the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father was Yu Jin [Left Provincial Administration Commissioner]; and his mother is Lady Xie [invested as Master's Wife (Anren)]. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Ruowen, Ruoyi, Ruozhu, Ruohao, Ruoji, Ruobin, and Ruocheng; his younger brother is Ruoqi. He married Lady Zhang, and subsequently married Lady Wang. He ranked second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Qizhi 陳其志 [registered in a civilian household of Putian County in Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Gongheng, second in generational order, age twenty-eight, born on the ninth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Boxian [Grand Master Exemplar, Surveillance Vice Commissioner in charge of Education]; his grandfather was Chen Dapei; his father is Chen Yingcong; his father's former wife was Lady Zheng; and his mother is Lady Lin. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). He married Lady Lin. He ranked fourteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Zhiji 周之基 [registered in a civilian household of Xiangtan County in Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jiqing, fourth in generational order, age thirty-one, born on the fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Gan; his grandfather was Zhou Sishi; his father is Zhou Xun [Annual Tribute Student, successively invested with the title of Director in the Nanjing Ministry of Personnel]; and his mother was Lady Yang [successively invested as Lady of Suitability (Yiren)]. His father is living (yanshi xia). His elder brothers are Zhiping [Provincial Surveillance Commissioner], Zhihan [District Magistrate], and Zhiguang [Annual Tribute Student]; his younger brothers are Zhiming and Zhilong. He married Lady Luo, and subsequently married Lady Xu. He ranked eleventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Bang 徐榜 [registered in a civilian household of Jing County in Ningguo Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xianfu, fourth in generational order, age thirty-three, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Lai; his grandfather is Xu Ji; his father is Xu Mu [Prefectural Registrar]; and his mother is Lady Dong. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His elder brothers are Cai, Fang, and Quan; his younger brother is Liang. He married Lady Dong. He ranked ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

李周策〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，吳江縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字獻卿，行一，年三十三，九月二十七日生〕。曾祖傳，祖牧，父紹美〔儒官〕，前母周氏，母顧氏。永感下。兄樑、楫、詔，弟詩、諤。娶徐氏，繼娶王氏。應天府鄉試第十八名，會試第一百五十二名。

秦嵩〔貫湖廣鄖陽府鄖縣民籍，直隸蘇州府吳縣人，直隸內丘縣學教諭，治《書經》，字中望，行一，年三十三，十二月二十六日生〕。曾祖慶，祖秉仁，父黻，母毛氏，繼母李氏。永感下。兄山。娶卜氏，繼娶徐氏。湖廣鄉試第十一名，會試第一百六十六名。

錢汝梁〔貫浙江湖州府歸安縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字用甫，行二，年三十三，九月初六日生〕。曾祖瓊，祖傑，父明〔壽官〕，母宋氏。具慶下。兄汝棟。娶李氏。浙江鄉試第六十八名，會試第九十八名。

周子文〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，常州府無錫縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字岐陽，行八，年三十五，二月初九日生〕。曾祖訓，祖泶〔進士〕，父于德〔翰林院孔目〕，嫡母凌氏，生母龔氏。永感下。兄子魯。娶李氏，繼娶李氏。應天府鄉試第五十名，會試第一百二十五名。
translation_en:
Li Zhouce 李周策 [registered as a commoner in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), originally from Wujiang County; Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xianqing; first in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Chuan, his grandfather was Li Mu, his father was Li Shaomei [Confucian Official], his father's first wife was née Zhou, and his mother was née Gu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Li Liang, Li Ji, and Li Zhao; his younger brothers are Li Shi and Li E. He married née Xu, and later married née Wang. He placed eighteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Song 秦嵩 [registered as a commoner in Yun County, Yunyang Prefecture, Huguang, originally from Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Instructor in the Neiqiu County Confucian School in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili), specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhongwang; first in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Qin Qing, his grandfather was Qin Bingren, his father was Qin Fu, his mother was née Mao, and his stepmother was née Li. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Qin Shan. He married née Bu, and later married née Xu. He placed eleventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Ruliang 錢汝梁 [registered as a commoner in Gui'an County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yongfu; second in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Qian Qiong, his grandfather was Qian Jie, his father is Qian Ming [Honorary Official for Longevity], and his mother is née Song. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Qian Rudong. He married née Li. He placed sixty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Ziwen 周子文 [registered as a commoner in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), originally from Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture; Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Qiyang; eighth in his generation; age thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Xun, his grandfather was Zhou Xue [metropolitan graduate (jinshi)], his father was Zhou Yude [Archivist in the Hanlin Academy], his legal mother was née Ling, and his birth mother was née Gong. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zhou Zilu. He married née Li, and later married another née Li. He placed fiftieth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

江中信〔貫山東東昌府臨清州民籍，浙江杭州府仁和縣人，州學生，治《詩經》，字汝成，行三，年二十七，九月二十二日生〕。曾祖永〔壽官〕，祖瓚〔七品散官〕，父河，母方氏。重慶下。兄中化〔監生〕、中舟，弟中楫、中正、中金、中方、中守、中裕、中虛。娶朱氏。山東鄉試第六名，會試第三百五十名。

張問達〔貫陝西西安府涇陽縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字德允，行四，年三十九，九月二十六日生〕。曾祖璟〔壽官〕，祖鎬〔封徵仕郎、衛經歷〕，父汝騋〔州判官〕，母韓氏〔贈孺人〕，繼母熊氏。嚴侍下。兄問仁、問明、問政。娶何氏，繼娶吳氏，繼聘劉氏。陝西鄉試第四名，會試第二百三十四名。

舒弘緒〔貫湖廣武昌府興國州通山縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字崇孝，行一，年二十八，四月十一日生〕。曾祖玉高〔壽官〕，祖有爵，父彥〔訓導〕，母夏氏。嚴侍下。兄弘猷〔王府引禮舍人〕、弘謨、弘績。娶袁氏。湖廣鄉試第三十五名，會試第三百四十三名。

translation_en:
Jiang Zhongxin 江中信 (registered under a civilian household in Linqing Subprefecture 臨清州, Dongchang Prefecture 東昌府, Shandong 山東, originally from Renhe County 仁和縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a subprefectural student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rucheng 汝成; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Jiang Yong 永 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Jiang Zan 瓚 (Honorific Official of the Seventh Rank); his father is Jiang He 河; and his mother is née Fang 方氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Jiang Zhonghua 中化 (National University Student) and Jiang Zhongzhou 中舟, and his younger brothers are Jiang Zhongji 中楫, Jiang Zhongzheng 中正, Jiang Zhongjin 中金, Jiang Zhongfang 中方, Jiang Zhongshou 中守, Jiang Zhongyu 中裕, and Jiang Zhongxu 中虛. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed 6th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 350th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wenda 張問達 (registered under a military household in Jingyang County 涇陽縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Deyun 德允; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Jing 璟 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Zhang Hao 鎬 (enfeoffed as Gentleman forManifest Service and Guard Registry); his father is Zhang Rulai 汝騋 (SubprefecturalJudge); his mother was née Han 韓氏 (posthumously honored as Child-Nurturess); and his stepmother was née Xiong 熊氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Wenren 問仁, Zhang Wenming 問明, and Zhang Wenzheng 問政. He married née He 何氏, remarried née Wu 吳氏, and was subsequently betrothed to née Liu 劉氏. He placed 4th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 234th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shu Hongxu 舒弘緒 (registered under a military household in Tongshan County 通山縣, Xingguo Subprefecture 興國州, Wuchang Prefecture 武昌府, Huguang 湖廣; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Chongxiao 崇孝; first in seniority in his generation; aged twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Shu Yugao 玉高 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Shu Youjue 有爵; his father is Shu Yan 彥 (Assistant Instructor); and his mother was née Xia 夏氏. His father is living. His elder brothers (or cousins) are Shu Hongyou 弘猷 (Usher in a Princely Establishment), Shu Hongmo 弘謨, and Shu Hongji 弘績. He married née Yuan 袁氏. He placed 35th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 343rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Duan Keyun 段克允 (registered under a civilian household in Hukou County 湖口縣, Jiujiang Prefecture 九江府, Jiangxi 江西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ziming 子明; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the seventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Duan Gui 珪; his grandfather was Duan Luan 鑾 (posthumously honored as Surveillance Vice Commissioner); his father was Duan Mengxuan 孟萱 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father's first wife was née Mei 梅氏; and his mother was née Cui 崔氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Duan Keqin 克勤, Duan Kemo 克模, and Duan Kejian 克儉, and his younger brothers are Duan Kexiao 克孝 (National University Student), Duan Keyou 克友, and Duan Keju 克舉 (National University Student). He married née Ning 甯氏. He placed 91st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 66th in the Metropolitan Examination.

孫湛吾〔貫山東濟南府淄川縣軍籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字涵虛，行一，年二十七，十二月初十日生〕。曾祖鐸；祖尚禮；父弼〔教諭〕；母韓氏、趙氏。具慶下。弟澄吾、淑吾。娶聶氏，繼娶李氏。山東鄉試第四十三名，會試第二百五十三名。
柯茂竹〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字堯叟，行二，年二十八，三月二十九日生〕。曾祖英〔知府〕；祖維騏〔主事，進階承德郎致仕〕；父植；母黃氏。嚴侍下。兄瑩；弟壽愷、壽寧、壽臧、壽耈、壽域、壽星。娶方氏。福建鄉試第六十八名，會試第九十一名。
崔謙亨〔貫直隸大名府魏縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字會卿，行三，年二十五，十二月十八日生〕。曾祖福玘；祖剛；父文進〔壽官〕；前母李氏，母武氏。慈侍下。兄謙光〔貢士〕、謙吉。娶薛氏，繼娶劉氏。順天府鄉試第六十名，會試第三百四名。
李化龍〔貫山東濟南府章丘縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字惟時，行二，年二十七，正月十四日生〕。曾祖正；祖貫〔省祭官〕；父道〔壽官〕；前母劉氏，母劉氏。具慶下。兄東泰；弟化蛟、化雨、化遠、化行。娶宋氏。山東鄉試第六十五名，會試第二百八十八名。
translation_en:
Sun Zhanwu 孫湛吾 [registered in a military household of Zichuan County 淄川縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; a County Student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Hanxu 涵虛; first in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Duo 鐸; his grandfather was Sun Shangli 尚禮; his father is Sun Bi 弼 [Instructor (jiaoyu)]; his mothers are Lady Han 韓氏 and Lady Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Sun Chengwu 澄吾 and Sun Shuwu 淑吾. He married Lady Nie 聶氏, and subsequently married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked 43rd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 253rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ke Maozhu 柯茂竹 [registered in a civilian household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Yaosou 堯叟; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Ke Ying 英 [Prefect (zhifu)]; his grandfather was Ke Weiqi 維騏 [Bureau Secretary (zhushi), advanced in prestige title to Gentleman for Fostering Virtue (chengde lang) and retired]; his father is Ke Zhi 植; his mother was Lady Huang 黃氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased (yanshi xia). His elder brother is Ke Ying 瑩; his younger brothers are Ke Shoukai 壽愷, Ke Shouning 壽寧, Ke Shouzang 壽臧, Ke Shougou 壽耈, Ke Shouyu 壽域, and Ke Shouxing 壽星. He married Lady Fang 方氏. He ranked 68th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 91st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cui Qianheng 崔謙亨 [registered in a civilian household of Wei County 魏縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili 直隸; a County Student specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Huiqing 會卿; third in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Cui Fuqi 福玘; his grandfather was Cui Gang 剛; his father was Cui Wenjin 文進 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his father's former wife was Lady Li 李氏, and his mother is Lady Wu 武氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Cui Qianguang 謙光 [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination Graduate awaiting the Palace Examination (gongshi)] and Cui Qianji 謙吉. He married Lady Xue 薛氏, and subsequently married Lady Liu 劉氏. He ranked 60th in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 304th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Hualong 李化龍 [registered in a military household of Zhangqiu County 章丘縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; a County Student specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Weishi 惟時; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the fourteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Li Zheng 正; his grandfather was Li Guan 貫 [Subordinate Functionary Sent Home on Leave to Visit Ancestral Graves (xingji guan)]; his father is Li Dao 道 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his father's former wife was Lady Liu 劉氏, and his mother is Lady Liu 劉氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Li Dongtai 東泰; his younger brothers are Li Huajiao 化蛟, Li Huayu 化雨, Li Huayuan 化遠, and Li Huaxing 化行. He married Lady Song 宋氏. He ranked 65th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 288th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Ning Cheng 甯𫞩 [Vice Commander], his grandfather was Ning Chu 甯楚 [Vice Commander], his father was Ning Xiwu 甯希武 [Vice Commander], and his mother is née Yao [invested as Lady of Virtue]. His mother is living. His elder brother is Ning Zhonghe 甯中和 [Vice Commander]. He married née Wang. He ranked thirty-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Feng 楊鳳 [registered in a civilian household of Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yiyu; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six; born on the twelfth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Wenxiu 楊文秀 [invested as Grand Master for Governance and Director in the Ministry of Justice], his grandfather is Yang Benyi 楊本義 [Student of the Directorate of Education], his father is Yang Dawu 楊大武, and his mother is née Yuan. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Yang Long 楊龍 and Yang Zhi 楊豸. He married née Jiang. He ranked first in the Henan Provincial Examination and three hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhidong 王之棟 [registered in a civilian household of Ningjin County, Zhao Department, Zhending Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area; a county student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yanglong; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven; born on the twenty-fifth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Heng 王亨, his grandfather is Wang Jiang 王獎 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age], his father is Wang Keshen 王克慎 [County Magistrate], and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Zhicai 王之材, Wang Zhiji 王之楫, and Wang Zhimei 王之梅. He married née Gao. He ranked second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yingyang 張應揚 [registered in a civilian household of Xiuning County, Huizhou Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area; a supernumerary county student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongyan; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven; born on the second day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Gui 張珪, his grandfather was Zhang Zong'ao 張宗鰲, his father was Zhang Xuan 張宣, his legal mother was née Wu, and his birth mother is née Ni. His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhang Yinglun 張應掄, and his younger brother is Zhang Yingzhen 張應振. He married née Wu. He ranked ninetieth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Huiyou 李徽猷 (registered in a military household of Linyi County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; an Additional Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bojian; first in his generation; aged twenty, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Wang, his grandfather was Li Qing, his father is Li Cui, his mother was née Wang, and his stepmothers were née Qin and née Zhu. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His younger brother is Hongyou. He married née Zhang. He placed 12th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 69th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Chunjing 范醇敬 (registered in a civilian household of Jiading Subprefecture, Sichuan; a Subprefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zihou; second in his generation; aged twenty-one, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Fan Lian, his grandfather was Fan Meng ([埧?]), his father is Fan Erzhi, and his mother is née Tong. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Lujing, and his younger brothers are Hengjing and Hejing. He married née Wen. He placed 9th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 249th in the Metropolitan Examination.

You Yinglu 尤應魯 (registered in a civilian household of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a Confucian Scholar specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Eryan; fifth in his generation; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was You Huan (Honorary Official of Longevity), his grandfather was You Cong (posthumously honoured as District Magistrate), his father was You Qi (Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue), his father's former wives were née Wu and née Lin (posthumously honoured as Child Nurturesses), and his mother is née Xu (invested as Child Nurturess). His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yingfu, Yinghui, Yingheng, Yingwu, Yingkui, Yingchun, and Yingjie; his younger brothers are Yingji and Yingbiao; and his nephew is Fu. He married née Wang and is subsequently betrothed to née Huang. He placed 46th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 158th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Fengqi 沈鳳岐 (registered as a banner soldier in the Standard-Bearer Guard, native to Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dehui; first in his generation; aged thirty, born on the first day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Shen Ze, his grandfather was Shen Gui, his father is Shen Jie (Honorary Official of Longevity), and his mother is née Liu. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Fengxiang. He married née Xu, and took née Jin as his second wife. He placed 86th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 240th in the Metropolitan Examination.

王有功〔貫直隸蘇州府吳江縣軍籍，吳縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字可大，行二，年三十一，十一月十二日生〕。曾祖惠，祖誥，父寵光，母伊氏。永感下。兄有德，弟有貞。娶查氏。應天府鄉試第一百二名，會試第四十六名。

楊紹程〔貫陝西鳳翔府岐山縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字儒系，行一，年三十五，十一月十五日生〕。曾祖恭〔中憲大夫、通政司右通政〕，祖暉〔王府典簿〕，父楠〔知縣〕，前母景氏，母劉氏。慈侍下。兄繼程，弟統程、纘程。娶武氏，繼娶景氏。陝西鄉試第四名，會試第二百七十九名。

丁應泰〔貫湖廣武昌左衛官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元父，行三，年三十一，閏九月十二日生〕。曾祖隆〔指揮〕，祖鉞〔署都指揮〕，父奎〔指揮〕，母劉氏〔封恭人〕。慈侍下。兄應昌〔指揮〕、應祥，弟應亨、應召、應聘、應鳴。娶羅氏。湖廣鄉試第六十二名，會試第一百五十七名。
translation_en:
Tu Zongjun 涂宗濬 (registered in a civilian household of Nanchang County 南昌縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; a supernumerary student of the prefectural school; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; style name Jifu 及甫; sixth in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Tu Ben 本, his grandfather Tu Gao 高, his father Tu Gang 綱, and his mother Lady Wang 王氏. His mother is living (his father having died). His younger brothers are Zonghao 宗灝, Zongjin 宗漌, Zongxun 宗洵, Zongcheng 宗澄, Zongshu 宗淑, and Zongze 宗澤; he married Lady Yu 余氏. He placed forty-sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yougong 王有功 (registered in a military household of Wujiang County 吳江縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸], originally from Wu County 吳縣; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; style name Keda 可大; second in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Hui 惠, his grandfather Wang Gao 誥, his father Wang Chongguang 寵光, and his mother Lady Yi 伊氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Youde 有德, and his younger brother is Youzhen 有貞; he married Lady Zha 查氏. He placed one hundred second in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Shaocheng 楊紹程 (registered in a civilian household of Qishan County 岐山縣, Fengxiang Prefecture 鳳翔府, Shaanxi 陝西; a student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; style name Ruxi 儒系; first in his generation; age thirty-five, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Yang Gong 恭 (Grand Master exemplar, Right Office Transmission Commissioner in the Office of Transmission), his grandfather Yang Hui 暉 (Archivist in a Princely Establishment), his father Yang Nan 楠 (County Magistrate), his father's former wife Lady Jing 景氏, and his mother Lady Liu 劉氏. His mother is living (his father having died). His elder brother is Jicheng 繼程, and his younger brothers are Tongcheng 統程 and Zuancheng 纘程; he married Lady Wu 武氏, and took Lady Jing 景氏 as his second wife. He placed fourth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Yingtai 丁應泰 (registered in a military officer household of the Wuchang Left Guard 武昌左衛, Huguang 湖廣; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Yuanfu 元父; third in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the twelfth day of the intercalary ninth month). His great-grandfather was Ding Long 隆 (Guard Commander), his grandfather Ding Yue 鉞 (Acting Regional Military Commissioner), his father Ding Kui 奎 (Guard Commander), and his mother Lady Liu 劉氏 (invested as Mistress of Respect). His mother is living (his father having died). His elder brothers are Yingchang 應昌 (Guard Commander) and Yingxiang 應祥, and his younger brothers are Yingheng 應亨, Yingzhao 應召, Yingping 應聘, and Yingming 應鳴; he married Lady Luo 羅氏. He placed sixty-second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

吳華〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字子實，行三，年三十四，七月初一日生〕。曾祖道厚；祖天民；父流川；母朱氏；繼母陳氏。具慶下。兄啓元；弟著、芳、萃。娶熊氏。福建鄉試第三十八名，會試第三十九名。

萬國欽〔貫江西南昌府新建縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字和甫，行四，年三十一，九月二十九日生〕。曾祖子金；祖海；父桶；母趙氏。慈侍下。兄國彰；弟國隆。娶江氏。江西鄉試第二名，會試第九名。

蕭汝芳〔貫遼東鐵嶺衛官籍，江西吉安府泰和縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字斯妍，行四，年三十一，五月初七日生〕。曾祖景德；祖永福〔訓導〕；父鳳雝〔歲貢生〕；母傅氏。具慶下。兄汝芝〔禦備〕、汝蘭〔監生〕、汝芩；弟汝荷、汝華〔千戶〕。娶張氏。順天府鄉試第十名，會試第二百七十名。

顏洪範〔貫浙江紹興府上虞縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字中起，行一，年二十九，八月初一日生〕。曾祖燁〔知府〕；祖奎；父天錫〔巡檢〕；母范氏。具慶下。兄洪才、洪業；弟洪謨、洪度、洪勳、洪烈、洪節。娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第五十二名，會試第八十七名。
translation_en:
Wu Hua 吳華 (registered in a commoner household in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zishi 子實; third in his generation; aged thirty-four; born on the first day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wu Daohou 道厚; his grandfather was Wu Tianmin 天民; his father was Wu Liuchuan 流川; his mother was Lady Zhu 朱氏; his stepmother is Lady Chen 陳氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Wu Qiyuan 啓元; his younger brothers are Wu Zhu 著, Wu Fang 芳, and Wu Cui 萃. He married Lady Xiong 熊氏. He ranked thirty-eighth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wan Guoqin 萬國欽 (registered in a commoner household in Xinjian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Hefu 和甫; fourth in his generation; aged thirty-one; born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wan Zijin 子金; his grandfather was Wan Hai 海; his father was Wan Tong 桶; his mother is Lady Zhao 趙氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Wan Guozhang 國彰; his younger brother is Wan Guolong 國隆. He married Lady Jiang 江氏. He ranked second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Rufang 蕭汝芳 (registered in an official household in Tieling Guard, Liaodong, originally from Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Siyan 斯妍; fourth in his generation; aged thirty-one; born on the seventh day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Jingde 景德; his grandfather was Xiao Yongfu 永福 (Assistant Instructor); his father is Xiao Fengyong 鳳雝 (Annual Tribute Student); his mother is Lady Fu 傅氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiao Ruzhi 汝芝 (Defense Command Officer [?]), Xiao Rulan 汝蘭 (National University Student), and Xiao Ruqin 汝芩; his younger brothers are Xiao Ruhe 汝荷 and Xiao Ruhua 汝華 (Battalion Commander). He married Lady Zhang 張氏. He ranked tenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Hongfan 顏洪範 (registered in a commoner household in Shangyu County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Zhongqi 中起; first in his generation; aged twenty-nine; born on the first day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yan Ye 燁 (Prefect); his grandfather was Yan Kui 奎; his father is Yan Tianxi 天錫 (Police Chief); his mother is Lady Fan 范氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers (or cousins) are Yan Hongcai 洪才 and Yan Hongye 洪業; his younger brothers are Yan Hongmo 洪謨, Yan Hongdu 洪度, Yan Hongxun 洪勳, Yan Honglie 洪烈, and Yan Hongjie 洪節. He married Lady Chen 陳氏. He ranked fifty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

張燁〔貫山東濟南府濱州匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字斂華，行四，年三十，二月十八日生〕。曾祖鸞；祖隆；父大孝，母吳氏。永感下。兄化、仕、翯，弟炤、翠、怡、悌。娶王氏。山東鄉試第十九名，會試第二百九十六名。

葛曦〔貫山東濟南府德州德平縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字仲明，行二，年二十九，七月十五日生〕。曾祖環〔累贈資政大夫、都察院左都御史〕；祖守禮〔資政大夫、都察院左都御史，加太子少保致仕，贈太子太保，謚端肅〕；父引生〔累贈戶部員外郎〕，母靳氏〔累贈宜人〕。重慶下。兄昕〔工部郎中〕，弟睨、晧、曉、昹、晼。娶任氏。山東鄉試第一名，會試第二百五十六名。

俞士章〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝成，行一，年二十六，五月初十日生〕。曾祖仁〔壽官〕；祖琰〔封南京吏部主事〕；父霑〔南京吏部主事〕，母陸氏。重慶下。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第一百四名，會試第七名。

張惟方〔貫福建漳州府龍溪縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字崇仁，行四，年三十四，九月初八日生〕。曾祖宜茂；祖秉華；父榮平〔壽官〕，前母阮氏，母曹氏。慈侍下。兄惟正、惟修〔典史〕、惟毅、猷〔省祭官〕，弟惟藻、惟渾、惟材。娶曾氏。順天府鄉試第三十五名，會試第九十二名。
translation_en:
Zhang Ye 張燁 [registered under an artisan household in Binzhou 濱州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Lianhua 斂華; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the eighteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Luan 鸞; his grandfather was Zhang Long 隆; his father was Zhang Daxiao 大孝, and his mother was Lady Wu 吳氏. Both parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brothers are Zhang Hua 化, Zhang Shi 仕, and Zhang He 翯; his younger brothers are Zhang Zhao 炤, Zhang Cui 翠, Zhang Yi 怡, and Zhang Ti 悌. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed 19th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 296th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ge Xi 葛曦 [registered under a military household in Deping County 德平縣, Dezhou 德州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); style name Zhongming 仲明; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month]. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Lianfang, Li Qifang, and Li Maofang. He is married to née Chang. He placed thirty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Zhizhi 高知止 (registered under a civilian household in Pingyuan County, Dezhou, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Mingfu; first in seniority; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month). 許國誠〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣，軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字鼎臣，行一，年三十四，九月初八日生〕。曾祖純；祖鳳；父執中〔封承德郎、南京禮部主事〕；母王氏〔封安人〕。慈侍下。弟國瓚〔戶部主事〕、國誼、國謨。娶李氏，繼娶翁氏。福建鄉試第八名，會試第一百十四名。

周昊〔貫浙江金華府蘭谿縣，民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字日明，行九十七，年三十二，三月十三日生〕。曾祖文和；祖法鑾；父策；母黃氏。具慶下。兄易、冕、杲；弟𦊰。娶嚴氏，繼娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百四十三名。

張天德〔貫浙江湖州府烏程縣，民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字新吾，行三，年三十一，十月初十日生〕。曾祖璿〔贈都察院左都御史〕；祖傑〔贈都察院左都御史〕；父永明〔都察院左都御史，贈太子少保，諡莊僖〕；母楊氏〔封夫人〕。永感下。兄天馭〔典史〕、天秩〔貢士〕、天相〔監生〕、天騏、天樞。娶施氏。順天府鄉試第五十五名，會試第二百十五名。
translation_en:
Xu Guocheng 許國誠 (registered in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under military registration; a Directorate Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Dingchen; first in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Chun; his grandfather was Xu Feng; his father was Xu Zhizhong (invested as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Rites); and his mother is Lady Wang (invested as Mistress of Peace). His mother is living (cishi xia). His younger brothers are Xu Guozan (Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue), Xu Guoyi, and Xu Guomo. He married Lady Li, and subsequently married Lady Weng. He placed 8th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 114th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Hao 周昊 (registered in Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Riming; ninety-seventh in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Wenhe; his grandfather was Zhou Faluan; his father is Zhou Ce; and his mother is Lady Huang. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Zhou Yi, Zhou Mian, and Zhou Gao; his younger brother is Zhou 𦊰 [?]. He married Lady Yan, and subsequently married Lady Chen. He placed 25th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 143rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Yingsu 楊應宿 (registered in Pucheng County, Hua Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, under military registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History; courtesy name Zongchen; fourth in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the eighteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Yang Gui; his grandfather was Yang Shou; his father was Yang Lun (Honorary Official for Longevity); and his mother is Lady Ma. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yang Yingpin, Yang Yingshi, and Yang Yingyuan. He married Lady Yuan. He placed 51st in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 128th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tiande 張天德 (registered in Wucheng County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History; courtesy name Xinwu; third in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Xuan (posthumously honored as Left Censor-in-chief of the Censorate); his grandfather was Zhang Jie (posthumously honored as Left Censor-in-chief of the Censorate); his father was Zhang Yongming (Left Censor-in-chief of the Censorate, posthumously honored as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, canonized as Zhuangxi); and his mother was Lady Yang (invested as Lady of Honor). Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brothers are Zhang Tianyu (District Jailor), Zhang Tianzhi (Tribute Student), Zhang Tianxiang (Directorate Student), Zhang Tianqi, and Zhang Tianshu. He married Lady Shi. He placed 55th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 215th in the Metropolitan Examination.

胡時麟〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣竈籍，國子生，治《書經》，字靈昭，行十四，年三十一，十二月二十日生〕。曾祖秉彝；祖苗；父子仁。前母沈氏，母范氏。具慶下。弟時鳳、時龍、時春、時雨。娶龔氏。浙江鄉試第七十六名，會試第三十五名。

蔣應震〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字蟄甫，行四，年二十八，十二月十三日生〕。曾祖稠；祖太；父芸。母沈氏，繼母余氏。具慶下。兄應雷、應霖、應霆；弟應霧、應靄。娶濮氏。應天府鄉試第一百八名，會試第二百二十七名。

陳良軸〔貫江西南昌府新建縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字鳳父，行九，年二十八，十一月初五日生〕。曾祖經；祖憲忠；父炣〔儀賓〕。母苕溪鄉君。具慶下。兄良輔、良翰、良卿；弟良仕、良佐、良選、良知。娶郭氏。江西鄉試第三十名，會試第八名。

translation_en:
Hu Shilin 胡時麟 (registered under a salt-producer household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Lingzhao 靈昭; fourteenth in seniority among his generation; aged thirty-one; born on the twentieth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Bingyi 秉彝; his grandfather was Miao 苗; his father is Ziren 子仁; his father's former wife was née Shen 沈, and his mother is née Fan 范. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Shifeng 時鳳, Shilong 時龍, Shichun 時春, and Shiyu 時雨. He married née Gong 龔. He placed 76th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 35th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Yingzhen 蔣應震 (registered under a civilian household in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili]; Added Student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zhefu 蟄甫; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-eight; born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Chou 稠; his grandfather was Tai 太; his father is Yun 芸; his mother was née Shen 沈, and his stepmother is née Yu 余. His father and stepmother are both living. His elder brothers are Yinglei 應雷, Yinglin 應霖, and Yingting 應霆; his younger brothers are Yingwu 應霧 and Ying'ai 應靄. He married née Pu 濮. He placed 108th in the Yingtian Prefectural [Southern Metropolitan] Provincial Examination and 227th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Liangzhou 陳良軸 (registered under a civilian household in Xinjian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals; courtesy name Fengfu 鳳父; ninth in seniority; aged twenty-eight; born on the fifth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Jing 經; his grandfather was Xianzhong 憲忠; his father is Ke 炣 (Consort of a Commandery/County Princess [yibin]); his mother is the Township Princess (xiangjun) of Tiaoxi 苕溪. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Liangfu 良輔, Lianghan 良翰, and Liangqing 良卿; his younger brothers are Liangshi 良仕, Liangzuo 良佐, Liangxuan 良選, and Liangzhi 良知. He married née Guo 郭. He placed 30th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 8th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Chengzhi 蔡承植 (registered under a military household in You County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; County School Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Yifa 以發; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-seven; born on the fifth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Guoxin 國信; his grandfather was Shu 樞; his father is Sizhou 思周 (Confucian Official); his mother is née He 何. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Chengke 承可, Chengtong 承同 (Annual Tribute Student), and Chengyou 承有; his younger brothers are Chenglai 承賚, Chengzhen 承楨, and Chengwan 承完. He married née Tan 譚. He placed 39th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 205th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jing Zhoujun 荊州俊 [registered in a military household in Yishi County 猗氏縣, Puzhou 蒲州, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西; originally from Jingyang County 涇陽縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; a student of the Yishi County School; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhangfu 章甫; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty; born on the ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Jing Huan 寰; his grandfather was Jing Kun 琨 [Prefectural Director of Studies]; his father is Jing Laigong 來貢 [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor]; his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏, and his stepmother was Lady Kong 孔氏. His father is living. His younger brothers are Zhoujie 州傑, Zhouru 州儒, Zhouzuo 州佐, Zhouren 州任, and Zhouyi 州儀. He married Lady Guo 郭氏. He placed third in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 142nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Chaoyao 林朝鑰 [registered in a civilian household in Nanhai County 南海縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; a student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xiping 希平; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the tenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Shitong 勢通; his grandfather was Lin Lin 麟; his father was Lin Shu 曙; his father's first wife was Lady Yang 楊氏, and his mother is Lady Shao 邵氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Chaoyu 朝鈺 and Chaoquan 朝銓. He married Lady Du 杜氏. He placed twentieth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 102nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Chuguang 何出光 [registered in a civilian household in Fugou County 扶溝縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; a County School student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhaowen 兆文; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine; born on the twentieth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was He Zheng 政; his grandfather was He Shiheng 世亨 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his father was He Cen 岑 [Assistant Prefect]; his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏. Ye Jimei 葉繼美 [registered in a civilian household in Jiashan County 嘉善縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江; a student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhanghan 章含; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the ninth day of the eleventh month]. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Zhongshu 仲叔; his younger brothers are Jihua 繼華, Jiying 繼英, and Jiyi 繼義. He married Lady Xia 夏氏. He placed twentieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Luming 劉鹿鳴 (registered in an artisan household in Xiangfu County 祥符縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zishi 子示; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Lun 倫; his grandfather was Liu Zan 瓚; his father is Liu Gui 貴 (Assistant Instructor); and his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Fengming 鳳鳴 (District Magistrate), and his younger brother is Liu Heming 鶴鳴. He married née Zhang 張氏, and remarried née Li 李氏. He placed 7th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 271st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Yingpin 楊應聘 (registered in a commoner household in Huaiyuan County 懷遠縣, Fengyang Prefecture 鳳陽府, Zhili 直隸; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhiyin 志尹; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Bin 賓 (Instructor, granted the prestige title of Director of a Bureau in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue); his grandfather was Yang Shixiu 時秀 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, advanced in prestige rank to Grand Master Exemplar); his father is Yang Fengchen 逢辰 (National University Student); and his mother is née Duan 段氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Yingshao 應韶 and Yang Yingzhao 應詔. He married née Li 李氏. He placed 135th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 252nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Liangxuan 徐良選 (registered in a military household in Longyou County 龍游縣, Quzhou Prefecture 衢州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Youyuan 幼元; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twelfth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Xu Min 旻; his grandfather was Xu Qin 欽; his father was Xu Tingchen 廷臣; and his mother is née Dai 戴氏. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His younger brothers are Xu Liangren 良任, Xu Liangji 良際, Xu Liangmo 良模, Xu Lianghan 良翰, Xu Liangju 良矩, and Xu Liangshao 良韶. He married née Cao 曹氏, and remarried née Yang 楊氏. He placed 40th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 222nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Changqi 沈昌期 (registered in a military household in Taicang Subprefecture 太倉州, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Zhili 直隸; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingji 廷際; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Kui 葵; his grandfather was Shen Shan 山; his father is Shen Wenming 文明; and his mother is née Yang 楊氏. Both of his parents are living. He married née Cai 蔡氏. He placed 16th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 105th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Liu Kai; his grandfather was Liu Huan (Consort of a Clan Princess, granted the prestige title Gentleman for Fostering Judgment); his father is Liu Xuan (County Magistrate); and his mother is née Xiong. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Buying (Tribute Student) and Liu Buxi (County Director of Studies), and his younger brothers are Liu Buzhi and Liu Buxie. He married née Li. He placed eleventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Daonan 林道楠 (registered in a saltern household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tingren; first in seniority; age twenty-five; born on the eighth day of the intercalary eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Lin Zonghui; his grandfather was Lin Chongzhong; his father is Lin Demei; and his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Lin Daoxiang and Lin Daoshu. He married née Chen. He placed twenty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Fengyi 曾鳳儀 (registered in a civilian household in Leiyang County, Hengzhou Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shunzheng; first in seniority; age twenty-eight; born on the thirtieth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zeng Kai; his grandfather was Zeng Benyuan; his father is Zeng Quan; and his mother is née Yan. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Zeng Fenglü. He married née Liu, and took née Peng as his second wife. He placed second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yue Yuansheng 樂元聲 (registered in a civilian household in Tongxiang County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, native of Jiaxing County; Supernumerary Student of the Jiaxing County School; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Zichu; first in seniority; age twenty-two; born on the thirteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yue Zhen (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather is Yue Shang; his father is Yue Jiude; and his mother is née Zhang. Both of his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Yue Zhongsheng, Yue Hesheng, Yue Jinsheng, and Yue Wusheng. He married née Shi. He placed forty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳九德〔貫福建鎮海衛軍籍，衛學生，治《詩經》，字懋夫，行四，年三十一，十二月十五日生〕。曾祖禎祥；祖漢傑；父道畿；母方氏；繼母黃氏。慈侍下。兄欽皐、九叙、桂郁；弟九疇、九州。娶翁氏，繼娶宋氏。福建鄉試第四十一名，會試第一百五十九名。

朱長春〔貫浙江湖州府烏程縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字太復，行二，年二十六，十一月初三日生〕。曾祖恂；祖山〔布政司都事〕；父應元〔訓導〕；母陳氏。重慶下。兄衍宗；弟長明。娶盧氏。浙江鄉試第二十八名，會試第十名。
translation_en:
Pan Dunfu 潘敦復 (registered under a civilian household in Xiajin County, Gaotang Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yanheng; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Pan Cheng; his grandfather was Pan Zhen; his father is Pan Long (Tribute Student [gongshi]); and his mother is Lady Jiang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Pan Dunhua, and he is married to Lady Yu. He placed forty-seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Binghao 陳秉浩 (registered under a civilian household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Weizhi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Lun; his grandfather was Chen Mengzhou; his father is Chen Shishao; and his mother is Lady Wang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Chen Bingji (Subprefectural Director of Studies [xuezheng]), and his younger brothers are Chen Bingjun, Chen Binglan, Chen Bingluo, and Chen Binghong. He married Lady Wang and remarried Lady Ouyang. He placed seventy-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Jiude 陳九德 (registered under a military household in Zhenhai Guard, Fujian; a student of the Guard School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Maofu; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Zhenxiang; his grandfather was Chen Hanjie; his father was Chen Daoji; his mother was Lady Fang; and his stepmother is Lady Huang. His stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Qingao, Chen Jiuxu, and Chen Guiyu, and his younger brothers are Chen Jiuchou and Chen Jiuzhou. He married Lady Weng and remarried Lady Song. He placed forty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Changchun 朱長春 (registered under a civilian household in Wucheng County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Taifu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Xun; his grandfather is Zhu Shan (Office Manager of a Provincial Administration Commission [buzhengsi dushi]); his father is Zhu Yingyuan (Assistant Instructor [xundao]); and his mother is Lady Chen. Both his grandparents and his parents are living. His elder brother is Zhu Yanzong, and his younger brother is Zhu Changming. He is married to Lady Lu. He placed twenty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
李復陽〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣，民籍，府學生，治《易經》，字宗誠，行八，年三十，二月初七日生〕。曾祖大輅；祖應樞；父尚卿，母雷氏。重慶下。兄復隆，弟復初、復春、復亨。娶涂氏。江西鄉試第六十一名，會試第二百二十一名。

沈權〔貫貴州永寧衛，官籍，河南開封府祥符縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字中行，行五，年三十一，二月十七日生〕。曾祖瑄〔百戶〕；祖淮〔千戶〕；父鯉〔指揮僉事，封懷遠將軍〕，母趙氏〔贈淑人〕，繼母石氏。慈侍下。兄梅〔兵部員外郎〕、桐、桂〔訓導〕、橋〔工部司務〕。娶羅氏。貴州鄉試第二名，會試第一百十六名。

楊文煥〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣，民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字太素，行一，年三十二，八月二十二日生〕。曾祖霓〔驛丞〕；祖謨；父山〔知州〕，母谷氏，繼母黃氏、徐氏。永感下。弟文允、文化、文兆、文亮、文冕。娶聞人氏。浙江鄉試第四名，會試第二百六名。

程文〔貫應天府上元縣，民籍，直隸徽州府歙縣人，國子生，治《春秋》，字質夫，行一，年三十四，十月初四日生〕。曾祖鎮宗；祖介甫〔醫官〕；父濛〔府知事〕，母葉氏，繼母靳氏。慈侍下。弟策、表、章。娶吳氏，繼娶陳氏。應天府鄉試第五十八名，會試第九十六名。
translation_en:
Li Fuyang 李復陽 (registered in Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian household registration; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zongcheng; eighth in seniority among his generation; aged thirty, born on the seventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Li Dalu, his grandfather was Li Yingshu, his father is Li Shangqing, and his mother is Lady Lei. His grandparents and parents are all living. His elder brother is Li Fulong, and his younger brothers are Li Fuchu, Li Fuchun, and Li Fuheng. He married Lady Tu. He ranked 61st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 221st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Quan 沈權 (registered in Yongning Guard, Guizhou, under military officer household registration, originally from Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhongxing; fifth in seniority among his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Shen Xuan (Platoon Commander), his grandfather was Shen Huai (Battalion Commander), his father was Shen Li (Assistant Guard Commander, enfeoffed as General for Cherishing the Distant), his mother was Lady Zhao (posthumously titled Lady of Virtue), and his stepmother is Lady Shi. His stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Shen Mei (Vice Director in the Ministry of War), Shen Tong, Shen Gui (Assistant Instructor), and Shen Qiao (Office Manager in the Ministry of Works). He married Lady Luo. He ranked 2nd in the Guizhou Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Wenhuan 楊文煥 (registered in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household registration; Directorate Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Taisu; first in seniority among his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Ni (Postal Relay Station Master), his grandfather was Yang Mo, his father was Yang Shan (Department Magistrate), his mother was Lady Gu, and his stepmothers were Lady Huang and Lady Xu. Both his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Yang Wenyun, Yang Wenhua, Yang Wenzhao, Yang Wenliang, and Yang Wenmian. He married Lady Wenren. He ranked 4th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 206th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Wen 程文 (registered in Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture, under civilian household registration, originally from She County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Directorate Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zhifu; first in seniority among his generation; aged thirty-four, born on the fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Cheng Zhenzong, his grandfather was Cheng Jiefu (Medical Officer), his father was Cheng Meng (Prefectural Administrative Clerk), his mother was Lady Ye, and his stepmother is Lady Jin. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Cheng Ce, Cheng Biao, and Cheng Zhang. He married Lady Wu, and after her death married Lady Chen. He ranked 58th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 96th in the Metropolitan Examination.

趙彥〔貫陝西延安府膚施縣軍籍，府學生，治《書經》，字毓美，行二，年二十五，九月二十八日生〕。曾祖養性〔王府典膳〕，祖仕〔知縣〕，父一麟〔儒官〕，母李氏。重慶下。弟章、童、璧、翊。娶索氏。陝西鄉試第三十五名，會試第一百四名。

姜鏡〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字永明，行五，年二十六，五月二十四日生〕。曾祖榮〔工部主事〕，祖應期〔贈按察司副使〕，父子羔〔行太僕寺卿，進階資治尹〕，前母吳氏〔贈恭人〕，母方氏〔封恭人〕。嚴侍下。兄鉞、鍾、明、倣、升陽、元陽、中陽、銓〔監生〕，弟輝陽、鈁、館、金。娶胡氏。浙江鄉試第一名，會試第一百五十六名。

張文華〔貫四川成都府內江縣官籍，國子生，治《書經》，字兩茂，行四，年二十八，十二月十一日生〕。曾祖鵬〔壽官〕，祖忠〔陰陽訓術〕，父叔應，嫡母高氏，生母明氏。具慶下。兄文芳、文英、季思〔知縣〕、文薦、言仁，弟文著、文策。娶石氏。四川鄉試第六十七名，會試第二百六十三名。

韓光曙〔貫直隸蘇州衛官籍，蘇州府學附學生，治《易經》，字明伯，行一，年三十二，正月二十九日生〕。曾祖洪〔百戶〕，祖璋，父譯，母周氏。重慶下。兄光顯，弟光輔、光裕、光霽、光發。娶滕氏。應天府鄉試第一百五名，會試第二百十三名。
translation_en:
Zhao Yan 趙彥 [registered in a military household in Fushi County 膚施縣, Yan'an Prefecture 延安府, Shaanxi 陝西; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Yumei 毓美; second in generational order; age twenty-five, born on the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Yangxing 趙養性 [Supervisor of the Kitchen in a Princely Establishment], his grandfather was Zhao Shi 趙仕 [County Magistrate], his father is Zhao Yilin 趙一麟 [Confucian Officer], and his mother is Lady Li 李氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zhao Zhang 趙章, Zhao Tong 趙童, Zhao Bi 趙璧, and Zhao Yi 趙翊. He is married to Lady Suo 索氏. He ranked thirty-fifth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Jing 姜鏡 [registered in a civilian household in Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Yongming 永明; fifth in generational order; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Jiang Rong 姜榮 [Secretary in the Ministry of Works], his grandfather was Jiang Yingqi 姜應期 [posthumously honored as Surveillance Vice Commissioner], his father is Jiang Zigao 姜子羔 [Chief Minister of a Branch Court of the Imperial Stud, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master for Assisting toward Good Governance], his father's former wife was Lady Wu 吳氏 [posthumously honored as Revered Lady], and his mother was Lady Fang 方氏 [invested as Revered Lady]. His father is living. His elder brothers are Jiang Yue 姜鉞, Jiang Zhong 姜鍾, Jiang Ming 姜明, Jiang Fang 姜倣, Jiang Shengyang 姜升陽, Jiang Yuanyang 姜元陽, Jiang Zhongyang 姜中陽, and Jiang Quan 姜銓 [ Directorate Student]; his younger brothers are Jiang Huiyang 姜輝陽, Jiang Fang 姜鈁, Jiang Guan 姜館, and Jiang Jin 姜金. He is married to Lady Hu 胡氏. He ranked first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wenhua 張文華 [registered in an official household in Neijiang County 內江縣, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Liangmao 兩茂; fourth in generational order; age twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Peng 張鵬 [Honorary Officer of Seniority], his grandfather was Zhang Zhong 張忠 [Prefectural Instructor of Yin-Yang], his father is Zhang Shuying 張叔應, his legal mother is Lady Gao 高氏, and his birth mother is Lady Ming 明氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Wenfang 張文芳, Zhang Wenying 張文英, Zhang Jisi 張季思 [County Magistrate], Zhang Wenjian 張文薦, and Zhang Yanren 張言仁; his younger brothers are Zhang Wenzhu 張文著 and Zhang Wence 張文策. He is married to Lady Shi 石氏. He ranked sixty-seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Guangshu 韓光曙 [registered in an official household in the Suzhou Guard 蘇州衛, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); Supernumerary Student of the Suzhou Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Mingbo 明伯; first in generational order; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Han Hong 韓洪 [Company Commander], his grandfather is Han Zhang 韓璋, his father is Han Yi 韓譯, and his mother is Lady Zhou 周氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Han Guangxian 韓光顯, and his younger brothers are Han Guangfu 韓光輔, Han Guangyu 韓光裕, Han Guangji 韓光霽, and Han Guangfa 韓光發. He is married to Lady Teng 滕氏. He ranked one hundred and fifth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Sancai 劉三才 (registered in a civilian household of Linshui County, Guang'an Subprefecture, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan; County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Ruli; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five; born on the eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Xiang 劉祥; his grandfather was Liu Jixian 劉繼仙; his father was Liu Lai 劉淶, and his mother was née Gan 甘氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Liu San聘 劉三聘, Liu Sanxi 劉三錫, and Liu Sanzhong 劉三重, and his younger brother is Liu Sanyang 劉三暘. He married née Liang 梁氏. He placed first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 232nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Xinyao 羅心堯 (registered in a civilian household of Dehua County, Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Prefectural School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yunzhong; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six; born on the ninth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Luo Ziying 羅子瑛; his grandfather was Luo Shousong 羅守松; his father is Luo Wen 羅文, and his mother is née Yang 楊氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Luo Xinshun 羅心舜 and Luo Xinyu 羅心禹. He married née Xing 邢氏. He placed 79th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 302nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zunxun 王遵訓 (registered in a civilian household of Ningling County, Guide Prefecture, Henan; a native of Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Ershao; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the twenty-first day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Qi 王杞; his grandfather was Wang Ming 王明; his father was Wang Lun 王倫, his father's first wife was née Wang 王氏, and his mother was née Li 李氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Wang Zunlu 王遵路, Wang Zundao 王遵道, Wang Zunlu 王遵魯, Wang Zunzhong 王遵忠, and Wang Zunxiao 王遵孝. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed 14th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 28th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yingdeng 張應登 (registered in a civilian household of Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; County School Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Yuche; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight; born on the fifth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Honghua 張洪化 (posthumously granted the title of Registrar of a Provincial Administration Commission); his grandfather was Zhang Bi 張弼 (Honorary Official for his advanced age); his father is Zhang Yao 張瑶 (Government Student granted the privilege of wearing an official cap and belt), his father's first wife was née Luo 駱氏, and his mother is née Luo 羅氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Kechen 張克臣 (granted the title of Censor), Zhang Yingqi 張應期, Zhang Yingpin 張應聘, and Zhang Yingshi 張應時, and his younger brothers are Zhang Yingtai 張應台, Zhang Yingju 張應舉, Zhang Yingtai 張應泰, and Zhang Yingjian 張應薦. He married née Liao 廖氏. He placed 70th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 160th in the Metropolitan Examination.
