translation_en:
Liu Zhen 劉鎮 [registered in a civilian household of Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yaju; sixth in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-three, born on the second day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Fu 劉福; his grandfather was Liu Meng 劉盟; his father was Liu Wen 劉文, and his mother was née Xiao 蕭. Both of his parents had passed away. His elder brother is Liu Yue 劉鉞. He married née Lin 林, and after her death married née Yan 嚴. He placed 48th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 130th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Xueyi 周學易 [registered in a military household of the Hangzhou Right Guard, Zhejiang, a native of Qiantang County; Instructor (jiaoyu) of the Confucian School of Yanling County, Henan; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zishi; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-three, born on the third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Tai 周泰; his grandfather was Zhou Zongren 周宗仁; his father was Zhou Jixian 周繼先, and his mother is née Wang 王. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Zhou Shu 周書 [Chief of Police (limu) of a Chief's Office], Zhou Xueshi 周學詩, and Zhou Xueli 周學禮. He married née Yan 嚴. He placed 62nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 16th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Fangyu 劉芳譽 [registered in a civilian household of Chenliu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; Student of the County Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shifu; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-five, born on the first day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Lan 劉瀾 [Department Magistrate]; his grandfather was Liu Xizhang 劉希張 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his father was Liu Yuren 劉欲仁 [Administrator (zhangshi) of a Princely Establishment], and his mother is née Huang 黃. His mother is living. His elder brother is Liu Fangwen 劉芳聞. He married a clanswoman (zongnü) of the Princely Establishment of Zhenping. He placed 3rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 145th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Yingzheng 任應徵 [registered in a civilian household of Langzhong County, Baoning Prefecture, Sichuan; Supernumerary Student (fuxuesheng) of the County Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenyong; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-five, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ren Yi 任儀 [Administration Vice Commissioner, posthumously promoted through successive grants to Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate]; his grandfather was Ren Weixian 任維賢 [Vice Minister of Justice in Nanjing]; his father was Ren Zhe 任悊, his birth mother was née Tang 唐, and his stepmother is née Ma 馬. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Ren Yingping 任應聘, and his younger brothers are Ren Yingqu 任應衢 and Ren Yingfu 任應復. He married née Ma 馬. He placed 15th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 289th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zheng 王政 (registered in a civilian household of Xiaoyi County, Fenzhou, Shanxi; County School Student; specialized in the Record of Rites; courtesy name Zhengzhi; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-three, born on the tenth day of the sixth month). Liu Wenzheng 劉文徵 [registered in the military category at the Yunnan Right Guard in Yunnan, originally from Datong County, Datong Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Maoxue; seventh in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the third day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Gui 劉桂; his grandfather was Liu Kun 劉昆 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his father was Liu Tiren 劉體仁 [Assistant Prefect]; and his mother is née Meng 孟. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Liu Dezheng 劉德徵 [Student of the Directorate of Education], Liu Xiuzheng 劉休徵, Liu Xiangzheng 劉祥徵, Liu Xinzheng 劉信徵 [Tribute Student], and Liu Shunzheng 劉順徵 [District Magistrate]; his younger brother is Liu Ningzheng 劉寧徵. He married née Zhang 張. He placed 4th in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 212th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cui Shiqi 崔士棨 [registered in the civilian category in Anyang County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Chuanfu; second in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the first day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Cui Sheng 崔陞 [Right Administration Vice Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master for Palace Attendance]; his grandfather was Cui Xian 崔銑 [Right Vice Minister of the Nanjing Ministry of Rites, posthumously honored as Minister and given the posthumous name Wenmin]; his father was Cui Ji 崔汲 [Usher in the Court of State Ceremonial]; his mother was née Ma 馬; and his stepmother is née Jiang 蔣. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Cui Shiyou 崔士槱 [Student by Inheritance]; his younger brother is Cui Shijie 崔士楶. He married née Li 李. He placed 44th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 81st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Zheng 馬拯 [registered in the civilian category in Wuding Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; Subprefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Jifu; first in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-third day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Deshui 馬德水; his grandfather was Ma Hai 馬海; his father was Ma Zhiren 馬志仁 [Annual Tribute Student]; and his mother is née Li 李. His mother is living. Hou Qingyuan 侯慶遠 (registered under a military household in Teng County 滕縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 兗州府, Shandong 山東; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Gongshan 公善, first in his generation; age thirty, born on the eleventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Hou Chen 臣; his grandfather is Hou Qi 騏; his father is Hou Weining 維寧; and his mother is Lady Sun 孫氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Hou Yinyuan 廕遠, Hou Biyuan 庇遠, and Hou Shuyuan 庶遠. He married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked 43rd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yi 劉奕 (registered under a civilian household in Macheng County 麻城縣, Huangzhou Prefecture 黃州府, Huguang 湖廣; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yuancheng 元承, seventeenth in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Qiben 啟本 (righteous official [yiguan]); his grandfather was Liu Xing 行 (Postal Relay Station Master, posthumously granted the title Gentleman for Literature and District Magistrate); his father is Liu Zibi 子弼 (Department Magistrate); and his mother is Lady Xu 徐氏 (invested as Child Nurturess [ruren]). Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Fang 方 (Assistant Prefect), Liu Jiao 交, Liu Liang 亮, Liu Yong 永, Liu Xie 燮, Liu Yu 育, Liu Bao 襃, and Liu Xiang 襄; his younger brothers are Liu Bian 卞, Liu Lian 亷, Liu Gun 衮, Liu Dan 亶, and Liu Geng 庚. He married Lady Zeng 曽氏. He ranked 4th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 67th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Qu 馮渠 (registered under an artisan household in Xincheng County 新城縣, Jianchang Prefecture 建昌府, Jiangxi 江西; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dafu 達甫, second in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Feng Shixu 時旭; his grandfather was Feng Shixiang 世祥; his father is Feng Xiju 希舉; and his mother is Lady Huang 黄氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Feng Hun 渾; his younger brothers are Feng Yuan 沅 and Feng Shaojing 紹京. He married Lady Zhou 周氏, and took Lady Huang 黄氏 as his second wife. He ranked 45th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 37th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zhujing 張主敬 (registered under a civilian household in Baixiang County 栢鄉縣, Zhao Department 趙州, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, Zhili 直隸; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Maoqian 茂倩, third in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the second day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Kui 揆 (longevity official [shouguan]); his grandfather was Zhang Can 璨 (Postal Relay Station Master); his father is Zhang Han 翰 (District Magistrate); his father's first wife was Lady An 安氏; and his mother is Lady Chu 褚氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Rujing 汝敬 (Student of the Directorate of Education [jiansheng]), Zhang Ruji 汝楫 (sacrificial inspector [xingjiguan]), Zhang Dujing 篤敬 (Student of the Directorate of Education), Zhang Ruzhou 汝舟 (Student of the Directorate of Education), Zhang Rulin 汝霖, and Zhang Ruyu 汝雨 (Government Student [shengyuan]). He married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked 4th in the Shuntian 順天府 Provincial Examination and 132nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Maochun 李茂春 [native of Qi County 杞縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; of artisan household registration; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weiyuan 蔚元; fifth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the ninth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Mei 美; his grandfather was Li Yue 岳 [posthumously granted the prestige title Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and the office of Transmission Commissioner in the Office of Transmission]; his father was Li Donglu 東魯 [successively ennobled as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Transmission Commissioner in the Office of Transmission]; his father's former wife was Lady Kong 孔氏 [successively posthumously titled Lady of Virtue (shuren)]; and his mother is Lady Bian 邊氏 [successively ennobled as Lady of Virtue]. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Li Huachun 華春 [Commander (zhihui)] and Li Jichun 際春 [Transmission Commissioner in the Office of Transmission], and his younger brother is Li Yichun 宜春. He married Lady Liu 劉氏, and subsequently married Lady Sheng 盛氏. He ranked 7th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 166th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Weikui 吳維魁 [native of Wucheng County 烏程縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江; of commoner household registration; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanfu 元甫; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the fifth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Qing 清; his grandfather was Wu Pei 珮; his father is Wu Shizheng 世正; and his mother was Lady Shen 沈氏. His father is living (yanshi xia). His younger brothers are Wu Weicong 維聰, Wu Weizhou 維周, and Wu Weixin 維新. He married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked 33rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 101st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Songru 董宋儒 [native of Yuancheng County 元城縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili 直隸; of commoner household registration; Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yingsu 應宿; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-seventh day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Zhong 忠 [Honorary Elder (shouguan)]; his grandfather was Dong Tingdui 廷對 [Assistant Prefect (tongpan)]; his father is Dong Yongwei 用威 [Instructor (jiaoshou)]; his mother was Lady Liu 劉氏; and his stepmother was Lady Li 李氏. His father is living (yanshi xia). His elder brother is Dong Jinbi 晋筆. He married Lady Zhang 張氏. He ranked 20th in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 244th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liang Quan 梁銓 [native of Renhe County 仁和縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; of commoner household registration; Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shuheng 叔衡; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the thirteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Liang Fu 福; his grandfather was Liang Shi 仕; his father was Liang Xuan 瑄 [Battalion Commander by purchase of rank (naji qianhu)]; his father's former wife was Lady Shen 沈氏; his legal mother was Lady Weng 翁氏; and his birth mother is Lady Jiang 蔣氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Liang Yue 鉞 [Tribute Student (gongshi)] and Liang Zhong 鍾 [Expectant Appointee (tingxuan guan)], and his younger brother is Liang Qi 錡. He married Lady Li 李氏. He ranked 3rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 64th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Yipeng 鄭一鵬 (registered as a commoner in Jiangshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a county student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingju; first in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Yunyang (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Zheng Gong; his father is Zheng Mu, and his mother is née Chai. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Zheng Yihe, Zheng Yihong, Zheng Yiyan, Zheng Yique, and Zheng Yiming. He married née Mao. He placed eighty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Xingyao 朱星耀 (registered under a military household in Guixi County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi; a county student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yingchun; ninth in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Wenlin; his grandfather was Zhu Xiu; his father is Zhu Tingzuo, and his mother is née Yu. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Zhu Xinghui, and his younger brothers are Zhu Xingkui, Zhu Xingtai, and Zhu Xinggong. He married née Liu. He placed eleventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and three hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Guangzu 李光祖 (registered as a commoner in Bao'an County, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a county student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kexiao; first in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Li Wen (Instructor); his grandfather was Li Tanran; his father was Li Jiabin, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. His younger brother is Li Guangyu. He married née Bai. He placed twenty-third in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and three hundred thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Sheng 郭陞 (registered under a military household in Xianning County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenjin; first in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Guo Gui (Administration Vice Commissioner of the Right); his grandfather was Guo Zhi (Tribute Student); his father is Guo Weixi (Confucian Official), and his mother was née Pu. His father is living. His younger brothers are Guo Shu, Guo Kan, Guo Zeng, Guo Yong, and Guo Dian. He married née Huang. He placed fourteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

[?] Ruxue □汝學 (registered under civilian status in Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Siyi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the fourth month). His mother is living. His younger brothers are Ruwen, Ruxiao, and Ruzi. He is married to Lady Tian. He placed fifty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Jimao 薛繼茂 (registered under military status in Ruicheng County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi, a native of Yongchang Guard in Yunnan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Demao; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Cheng; his grandfather was Xuan (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father is Cen (Tribute Student by Grace); and his mother is Lady Wu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Jifang, and his younger brothers are Jisheng and Jixin. He is married to Lady Pan. 林熙春〔貫廣東潮州府海陽縣民籍，府學增廣生，治《書經》，字志和，行四，年二十七，七月三十日生〕。曾祖養真；祖瓚；父喬櫝；母黃氏。具慶下。兄時炯。娶陳氏，繼娶曾氏。廣東鄉試第三十名，會試第一百十七名。

劉會〔貫福建泉州府惠安縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字逢甲，行三，年三十一，十一月二十日生〕。曾祖楷〔教諭〕；祖清；父錄；母王氏；繼母陳氏。慈侍下。兄詢英〔知縣〕、起宗；弟寅、詢儒、詢政、晋、春、寵、霞、冕。娶李氏。福建鄉試第六十名，會試第八十三名。

羅朝國〔貫江西南昌府新建縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字惟禎，行二，年二十八，九月初一日生〕。曾祖闢耕；祖慤；父起〔儒官〕；母雷氏；繼母丁氏。嚴侍下。兄朝冠、朝望、朝服、朝光。娶萬氏。江西鄉試第二十六名，會試第十二名。
translation_en:
Shen Zhiyin 沈之唫: registered under civilian household status in Wucheng County 烏程縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江; Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xingfu 性甫; fifth in generational order; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Shen Ruliang 沈汝梁; his grandfather was Shen Duan 沈端 (Tribute Student [gongshi]); his father was Shen Shu 沈塾 (successively enfeoffed as Chief Minister of the Nanjing Seals Office [Nanjing Shangbaosi qing]); his legal mother was Lady Min 閔氏 (enfeoffed as Mistress of Peace [anren], posthumously honored as Lady of Suitability [yiren]); his birth mother was Lady Wu 吳氏. Both parents are living (specifically, father and birth mother). His elder brothers are Shen Jiefu 沈節甫 (Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices [Taichangsi shaoqing]), Shen Zhiliu 沈之鎏, Shen Zhi'ao 沈之鏊, Shen Zhijian 沈之堅 (all three National University Students [jiansheng]), Shen Zhiyuan 沈之垣, Shen Zhijian 沈之鋻, Shen Zhimou 沈之鍪 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), Shen Zhifu 沈之釜, and Shen Zhisui 沈之鐆 (both National University Students); his younger brothers are Shen Zhihuang 沈之鑅 and Shen Zhili 沈之錅. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed 82nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 52nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Xichun 林熙春: registered under civilian household status in Haiyang County 海陽縣, Chaozhou Prefecture 潮州府, Guangdong 廣東; Added Student of the Prefectural School (fuxue zengguangsheng); specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhihe 志和; fourth in generational order; age twenty-seven, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Lin Yangzhen 林養真; his grandfather was Lin Zan 林瓚; his father was Lin Qiaodu 林喬櫝; his mother was Lady Huang 黃氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Lin Shijiong 林時炯. He married Lady Chen 陳氏, and subsequently married Lady Zeng 曾氏. He placed 30th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 117th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Hui 劉會: registered under civilian household status in Hui'an County 惠安縣, Quanzhou Prefecture 泉州府, Fujian 福建; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Fengjia 逢甲; third in generational order; age thirty-one, born on the twentieth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Liu Kai 劉楷 (Instructor [jiaoyu]); his grandfather was Liu Qing 劉清; his father was Liu Lu 劉錄; his mother was Lady Wang 王氏; his stepmother was Lady Chen 陳氏. His mother (stepmother) is living. His elder brothers are Liu Xunying 劉詢英 (District Magistrate [zhixian]) and Liu Qizong 劉起宗; his younger brothers are Liu Yin 劉寅, Liu Xunru 劉詢儒, Liu Xunzheng 劉詢政, Liu Jin 劉晋, Liu Chun 劉春, Liu Chong 劉寵, Liu Xia 劉霞, and Liu Mian 劉冕. He married Lady Li 李氏. He placed 60th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 83rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Chaoguo 羅朝國: registered under civilian household status in Xinjian County 新建縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weizhen 惟禎; second in generational order; age twenty-eight, born on the first day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Luo Pigeng 羅闢耕; his grandfather was Luo Que 羅慤; his father was Luo Qi 羅起 (Confucian Official [ruguan]); his mother was Lady Lei 雷氏; his stepmother was Lady Ding 丁氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Luo Chaoguan 羅朝冠, Luo Chaowang 羅朝望, Luo Chaofu 羅朝服, and Luo Chaoguang 羅朝光. He married Lady Wan 萬氏. He placed 26th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 12th in the Metropolitan Examination.

李芳先〔貫四川成都府漢州民籍，山西澤州沁水縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字元秀，行二，年二十七，十月初五日生〕。曾祖守正；祖虎雄〔壽官〕；父餘；母鍾氏，繼母謝氏。慈侍下。兄蓁先；弟華先、薦先、蕃先。娶黃氏。四川鄉試第五十四名，會試第一百八十六名。

徐學聚〔貫浙江金華府蘭谿縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字敬輿，行十四，年二十八，十一月十一日生〕。曾祖講；祖袍〔貢士，贈承德郎、工部主事〕；父用光〔工部郎中〕；母唐氏〔封安人〕。永感下。兄學允；弟學聖、學元、學質〔儒士〕、學貴〔監生〕、勉、懋、究、煒、恕、燁、通。娶王氏。浙江鄉試第八十七名，會試第九十九名。

translation_en:
Li Fangxian 李芳先 [Registered under civilian household status in Hanzhou 漢州, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川, originally from Qinshui County 沁水縣, Zezhou 澤州, Shanxi 山西; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); style name Yuanxiu 元秀; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven; born on the fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Shouzheng 守正; his grandfather was Li Huxiong 虎雄 [Longevity Official (shouguan)]; his father was Li Yu 餘; his mother was née Zhong 鍾氏, and his stepmother is née Xie 謝氏. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brother is Li Zhenxian 蓁先; his younger brothers are Li Huaxian 華先, Li Jianxian 薦先, and Li Fanxian 蕃先. He married née Huang 黃氏. He ranked 54th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 186th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Xueju 徐學聚 [Registered under civilian household status in Lanxi County 蘭谿縣, Jinhua Prefecture 金華府, Zhejiang 浙江; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Changes; style name Jingyu 敬輿; fourteenth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight; born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Jiang 講; his grandfather was Xu Pao 袍 [tribute student (gongshi), posthumously honored as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue (chengde lang) and Secretary in the Ministry of Works]; his father was Xu Yongguang 用光 [Director in the Ministry of Works]; his mother was née Tang 唐氏 [invested as Mistress of Peace (anren)]. Both his parents are deceased (yongganxia). His elder brother is Xu Xueyun 學允; his younger brothers are Xu Xuesheng 學聖, Xu Xueyuan 學元, Xu Xuezhi 學質 [Confucian scholar (rushi)], Xu Xuegui 學貴 [Student of the Directorate of Education (jiansheng)], Xu Mian 勉, Xu Mao 懋, Xu Jiu 究, Xu Wei 煒, Xu Shu 恕, Xu Ye 燁, and Xu Tong 通. He married née Wang 王氏. He ranked 87th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 99th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Huan 汪煥 [Registered under military household status in the Song County Independent Battalion 嵩縣守禦千戶所, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan 河南, originally from Xiuning County 休寧縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Wenzhong 文仲; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty; born on the fifth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Xuan 瑄 [Student of the Directorate of Education]; his grandfather was Wang Yang 洋 [District Magistrate]; his father is Wang Jingshen 景莘 [tribute student]; his mother is née Yang 楊氏. Both his parents are living (juqingxia). His younger brothers are Wang Can 燦, Wang Zhao 炤, Wang Hui 輝, and Wang Ye 燁. He married née Liang 梁氏. He ranked 5th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 184th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Longyun 盧龍雲 [Registered under military household status in Nanhai County 南海縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Changes; style name Shaocong 少從; first in seniority among brothers; Wanli [?; transcription error for 年, "age"] twenty-seven; born on the third day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Ying 英; his grandfather was Lu Bian 汴; his father is Lu Chong 寵; his mother is née Li 李氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Lu Longxiao 龍霄 and Lu Longyu 龍雨. He married née Huang 黃氏, and remarried née Wu 吳氏. He ranked 36th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 292nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

胡三省〔貫直隸順德府沙河縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字子唯，行一，年二十九，十月初三日生〕。曾祖博；祖績；父邦俊〔壽官〕；母宋氏。重慶下。弟三畏、三德、三重。娶李氏。順天府鄉試第三十名，會試第三百二十九名。

translation_en:
Liu Sizhuo 劉斯濯 [registered under an official household in Zhuolu Guard in Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Ruxin, second in generational order, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Qing 清; his grandfather was Liu Zhen 珎 [Longevity Official (Shouguan)]; his father was Liu Xian 賢 [Assistant Magistrate (Xiancheng)]; and his mother is née Wang 王. His mother is living (cishixia). He has an elder brother, Yingjing 應旌. He married a woman née Wang 王, and took as his second wife a woman née Wang 王. He placed 132nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 308th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Xingzu 宋興祖 [registered under a commoner household in Hanzhou, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, originally from Zhongjiang County, Tongchuan Subprefecture; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Rujie, fifth in generational order, aged thirty, born on the third day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Song Wang 王 [?]; his grandfather was Song Hai 海 [Longevity Official]; his father was Song Tinggui 廷珪; his father's former wife was née Wu 吳, and his mother is née Zhang 張. His mother is living. He has elder brothers Jizu 繼祖 [Vice Salt Distribution Commissioner (Yuntong), promoted in prestige rank to Grand Master of the Palace (Taizhong Dafu)], Xianzu 顯祖, Guangzu 光祖, Shuzu 述祖, and Zuanzu 纘祖, and younger brothers Yangzu 揚祖, Yinzu 蔭祖, and Shengzu 繩祖. He married a woman née Wang 王. He placed 23rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 340th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Sanxing 胡三省 [registered under a commoner household in Shahe County, Shunde Prefecture, Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of History; style name Ziwei, first in generational order, aged twenty-nine, born on the third day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Bo 博; his grandfather is Hu Ji 績; his father is Hu Bangjun 邦俊 [Longevity Official]; and his mother is née Song 宋. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). He has younger brothers Sanwei 三畏, Sande 三德, and Sanzhong 三重. He married a woman née Li 李. He placed 30th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 329th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Jiabin 周嘉賓 [registered under a commoner household in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of History; style name Zhongzhao, first in generational order, aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-first day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Shu 書 [Instructor (Jiaoyu)]; his grandfather is Zhou Kongtu 孔徒 [District Magistrate (Zhixian)]; his father is Zhou Jiechen 介臣; and his mother is née Zhang 張. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He has younger brothers Jiasong 嘉宋, Jiacha 嘉察, Jiahuai 嘉寏, Jianing 嘉寍, Jiaxuan 嘉宣, and Jiayan 嘉言. He married a woman née Liu 劉. He placed 17th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 344th in the Metropolitan Examination.

曹繼孝〔貫湖廣黃州府黃岡縣民籍，直隸南和縣學教諭，治《詩經》，字達卿，行二，年三十三，十二月初六日生〕。曾祖儼〔歲貢生〕；祖璞；父雲深，母王氏。慈侍下。兄美〔貢士〕、光〔貢士〕、繼英、繼忠、繼奎，弟繼第、繼禮、繼鶚。娶張氏。湖廣鄉試第二十名，會試第三十三名。

何應竒〔貫河南河南府陝州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字遇夫，行一，年三十一，十一月十二日生〕。曾祖澄；祖彪；父廷秀，母史氏。具慶下。娶姚氏，繼娶徐氏。河南鄉試第二十名，會試第一百七十四名。

董國光〔貫山東兗州府滕縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字士彥，行一，年二十六，正月初九日生〕。曾祖泰；祖政；父夢熊〔壽官〕，母李氏。具慶下。弟國器。娶黃氏。山東鄉試第二十八名，會試第三百十七名。
translation_en:
Dai Chaoyong 戴朝用 (registered in a civilian household of Jinxi County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; supernumerary student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Xiaosheng; thirty-sixth in seniority among brothers and male cousins; aged twenty-seven, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Dai You; his grandfather was Dai Jing; his father was Dai Tianrui, and his mother was née Hu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Dai Chaoqing and Dai Chaogang, and his younger brother is Dai Chaoming. He married a woman née Xu. He placed 41st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Jixiao 曹繼孝 (registered in a civilian household of Huanggang County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; Instructor of the Nanhe County School in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Daqing; second in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Cao Yan (Annual Tribute Student); his grandfather was Cao Pu; his father was Cao Yunshen, and his mother is née Wang. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brothers are Cao Mei (tribute student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier, gongshi), Cao Guang (tribute student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier, gongshi), Cao Jiying, Cao Jizhong, and Cao Jikui, and his younger brothers are Cao Jidi, Cao Jili, and Cao Ji'e. He married a woman née Zhang. He placed 20th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 33rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Yingqi 何應竒 (registered in a civilian household of Shanzhou, Henan Prefecture, Henan; student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yufu; first in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was He Cheng; his grandfather was He Biao; his father is He Tingxiu, and his mother is née Shi. Both of his parents are living. He married a woman née Yao, and took as his second wife a woman née Xu. He placed 20th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 174th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Guoguang 董國光 (registered in a civilian household of Teng County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiyan; first in seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the ninth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Dong Tai; his grandfather was Dong Zheng; his father is Dong Mengxiong (Honorary Official for Longevity), and his mother is née Li. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Dong Guoqi. He married a woman née Huang. He placed 28th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 317th in the Metropolitan Examination.

杜華先〔貫山東東昌府冠縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字孝卿，行一，年二十六，二月初四日生〕。曾祖勝，祖漢，父桐〔歲貢生〕，母劉氏。具慶下。弟華國。娶戴氏，繼娶戴氏。山東鄉試第一名，會試第一百二十三名。

趙世顯〔貫福建福州府侯官縣民籍，浙江嘉善縣儒學訓導，治《易經》，字仁甫，行一，年四十二，七月十四日生〕。曾祖宏〔教諭〕，祖纓，父卿，母邵氏。慈侍下。娶吳氏。福建鄉試第四十五名，會試第三百二十六名。

饒崙〔貫江西撫州府臨川縣民籍，南昌府進賢縣人，臨川縣學生，治《書經》，字廷宗，行四，年三十一，正月二十七日生〕。曾祖述，祖廉〔縣主簿〕，父國禎，母張氏。永感下。兄廷錫〔知縣〕，弟岳、位〔知縣〕、伸〔同科進士〕、嶔。娶高氏，繼娶喻氏。江西鄉試第五十八名，會試第二十四名。
translation_en:
Yao Siren 姚思仁 (registered in an artisan household in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History; courtesy name Shanzhang; seniority rank first; age twenty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yao Wei 緯; his grandfather was Yao Lie 烈; his father is Yao Lüdao 履道; his mother is Lady Gu 顧氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Siyi 思義, Sili 思禮, Siyan 思嚴, and Sizhi 思智. He married Lady Tang 唐氏. He placed 40th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 250th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Huaxian 杜華先 (registered in a military household in Guan County, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; County Student; specialized in the Classic of History; courtesy name Xiaoqing; seniority rank first; age twenty-six, born on the fourth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Du Sheng 勝; his grandfather was Du Han 漢; his father is Du Tong 桐 (Annual Tribute Student); his mother is Lady Liu 劉氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Huaguo 華國. He married Lady Dai 戴氏, and took another Lady Dai 戴氏 as his second wife. He placed 1st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 123rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Shixian 趙世顯 (registered in a civilian household in Houguan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Assistant Instructor in the Confucian School of Jiashan County, Zhejiang; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Renfu; seniority rank first; age forty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Hong 宏 (Instructor); his grandfather was Zhao Ying 纓; his father was Zhao Qing 卿; his mother is Lady Shao 邵氏. His father is deceased and his mother is living. He married Lady Wu 吳氏. He placed 45th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 326th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rao Lun 饒崙 (registered in a civilian household in Linchuan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; native of Jinxian County, Nanchang Prefecture; Linchuan County Student; specialized in the Classic of History; courtesy name Tingzong; seniority rank fourth; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-seventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Rao Shu 述; his grandfather was Rao Lian 廉 (County Assistant Magistrate); his father was Rao Guozhen 國禎; his mother was Lady Zhang 張氏. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Tingxi 廷錫 (District Magistrate); his younger brothers are Yue 岳, Wei 位 (District Magistrate), Shen 伸 (metropolitan graduate of the same examination), and Qin 嶔. He married Lady Gao 高氏, and took Lady Yu 喻氏 as his second wife. He placed 58th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 24th in the Metropolitan Examination.

盧大中〔貫直隸廣平府永年縣，民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字子致，行三，年三十一，五月初六日生〕。曾祖昌，祖麒，父廷珠，母楊氏。慈侍下。兄大節〔推官〕、大謨〔貢士〕，弟大順〔戶部主事〕、大道。娶杜氏，繼娶胡氏。順天府鄉試第八十八名，會試第三百十四名。
張光緒〔貫直隸河間衛軍籍，河間府滄州慶雲縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字孝伯，行一，年二十八，七月十三日生〕。曾祖偉〔按察司僉事〕，祖夢巖，父爾兆，母郭氏。重慶下。弟光紀、光裕、光禧。娶孫氏。順天府鄉試第五十名，會試第二百九十五名。
来三聘〔貫浙江紹興府蕭山縣，竈籍，國子生，治《書經》，字任卿，行二，年三十二，十一月十五日生〕。曾祖璘，祖鮤，父捷，母黃氏。嚴侍下。兄汝賢〔禮部主事〕、經濟〔按察司僉事〕、三省，弟三策、三接。娶張氏。應天府鄉試第一百二十九名，會試第六十二名。
牛應元〔貫陝西西安府涇陽縣，軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字子仁，行三，年二十五，三月初十日生〕。曾祖通，祖隆〔省祭官〕，父璠〔縣主簿〕，前母翟氏，母王氏。慈侍下。兄應奎〔省祭官〕、應辰、應宿，弟應麟。娶于氏。陝西鄉試第三十名，會試第八十五名。
translation_en:
Lu Dazhong 盧大中 [registered in Yongnian County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili, under civilian registration; a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zizhi, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Chang, his grandfather was Lu Qi, his father was Lu Tingzhu, and his mother is née Yang. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Lu Dajie [Prefectural Judge] and Lu Damo [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his younger brothers are Lu Dashun [Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue] and Lu Dadao. He married née Du, and subsequently married née Hu. He placed 88th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 314th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Guangxu 張光緒 [registered under military registration in Hejian Guard, Zhili, a native of Qingyun County, Cangzhou, Hejian Prefecture; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xiaobo, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Wei [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner], his grandfather is Zhang Mengyan, his father is Zhang Erzhao, and his mother is née Guo. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His younger brothers are Zhang Guangji, Zhang Guangyu, and Zhang Guangxi. He married née Sun. He placed 50th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 295th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lai Sanpin 来三聘 [registered in Xiaoshan County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under salt-producer registration (zaoji); a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Renqing, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Lai Lin, his grandfather was Lai Lie, his father is Lai Jie, and his mother was née Huang. His father is living (yanshi xia). His elder brothers are Lai Ruxian [Secretary in the Ministry of Rites], Lai Jingji [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner], and Lai Sanxing; his younger brothers are Lai Sance and Lai Sanjie. He married née Zhang. He placed 129th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 62nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Niu Yingyuan 牛應元 [registered in Jingyang County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, under military registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ziren, third in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-five, born on the tenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Niu Tong, his grandfather was Niu Long [Sacrificial Attendant (shengjiguan)], his father was Niu Fan [County Assistant Magistrate], his father's first wife was née Zhai, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Niu Yingkui [Sacrificial Attendant], Niu Yingchen, and Niu Yingsu; his younger brother is Niu Yinglin. He married née Yu. He placed 30th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 85th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
鍾若休〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣民籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字于集，行一，年三十四，正月十五日生〕。曾祖紹基；祖秀；父淮，母鄺氏。永感下。弟鴻休。娶何氏。廣東鄉試第十三名，會試第一百三十九名。

陳一言〔貫湖廣襄陽府南漳縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字愚悃，行一，年二十八，八月十六日生〕。曾祖順恭；祖充盈；父大倫，母晏氏。具慶下。弟一志、一中。娶吳氏。湖廣鄉試第二十八名，會試第一百三十七名。

陳汝麟〔貫直隸徐州衛官籍，州學生，治《詩經》，字仁夫，行三，年二十二，七月十三日生〕。曾祖鑑〔百戶〕；祖𨋄〔百戶〕；父永康〔鎮撫〕，母劉氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。兄汝龍〔百戶〕、汝鳳；弟汝鯨、汝鵬。娶劉氏。應天府鄉試第一百十六名，會試第二百八十五名。

張常〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字以綱，行四，年三十，七月初九日生〕。曾祖中；祖仕琢；父正學，母何氏。嚴侍下。兄純〔按察司按察使〕、問明〔歲貢生〕、時迪〔知州〕；弟邦紀、邦翰、邦綵、邦繩。娶湯氏。福建鄉試第六十六名，會試第五十一名。
translation_en:
Zhong Ruoxiu 鍾若休: Registered in a commoner household in Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, he is a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), with the courtesy name Yuji, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Zhong Shaoji; his grandfather was Zhong Xiu; his father was Zhong Huai, and his mother was née Kuang. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Zhong Hongxiu, and he is married to née He. He placed 13th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 139th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yiyan 陳一言: Registered in a commoner household in Nanzhang County, Xiangyang Prefecture, Huguang, he is a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Yukun, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Shungong; his grandfather was Chen Chongying; his father is Chen Dalun, and his mother is née Yan. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Chen Yizhi and Chen Yizhong, and he is married to née Wu. He placed 28th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 137th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Rulin 陳汝麟: Registered in an official household in the Xuzhou Guard, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), he is a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Renfu, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Chen Jian (Platoon Commander); his grandfather was Chen Zai [? 𨋄] (Platoon Commander); his father is Chen Yongkang (Judge), and his mother is née Liu (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Rulong (Platoon Commander) and Chen Rufeng; his younger brothers are Chen Rujing and Chen Rupeng; and he is married to née Liu. He placed 116th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 285th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Chang 張常: Registered in a commoner household in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, he is a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Yigang, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the ninth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhong; his grandfather was Zhang Shizhuo; his father is Zhang Zhengxue, and his mother was née He. His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Chun (Surveillance Commissioner of a Surveillance Commission), Zhang Wenming (Annual Tribute Student), and Zhang Shidi (Subprefectural Magistrate); his younger brothers are Zhang Bangji, Zhang Banghan, Zhang Bangcai, and Zhang Bangsheng; and he is married to née Tang. He placed 66th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 51st in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
陳舜仁〔貫應天府上元縣民籍，直隸蘇州府吳縣人。國子生，治《詩經》。字淳甫，行一，年二十九，十二月十九日生〕。曾祖頂，祖鏊，父維瀚，母殷氏，繼母奚氏。具慶下。弟舜義、舜禮。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第八十八名，會試第十九名。

廖道充〔貫四川成都府仁壽縣民籍。國子生，治《書經》。字見可，行一，年三十二，八月初三日生〕。曾祖永康，祖忠〔監生〕，父坤，母劉氏，繼母蒲氏、劉氏、楊氏。慈侍下。弟道光。娶張氏，繼娶李氏。順天府鄉試第十三名，會試第四十七名。

佘夢鯉〔貫福建鎮東衛軍籍，福州府福清縣人。縣學附學生，治《詩經》。字有達，行六，年二十八，三月十一日生〕。曾祖孔輝，祖允昭，父錕，母龔氏。永感下。弟雲龍、雲鴻。娶楊氏。福建鄉試第二十二名，會試第八十九名。

何選〔貫太醫院官籍，直隸蘇州府嘉定縣人。順天府學生，治《易經》。字靖卿，行三，年三十，八月初三日生〕。曾祖信〔王府良醫正〕，祖祥〔太醫院御醫〕，父雲鳳〔太醫院御醫〕，前母周氏，母李氏。永感下。兄惠〔醫士〕、卿、遷〔冠帶醫士〕、岳靈、岳秀，弟子忠、一桂、遴、子孝、過、述、迪。娶周氏。順天府鄉試第四十名，會試第三百三十二名。
translation_en:
Chen Shunren 陳舜仁 [registered in a civilian household of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture, and a native of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chunfu, first in seniority among his brothers, age twenty-nine, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Ding, his grandfather was Chen Ao, his father was Chen Weihan, his mother was née Yin, and his stepmother is née Xi. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Shunyi and Shunli. He married née Wang. He ranked eighty-eighth in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liao Daochong 廖道充 [registered in a civilian household of Renshou County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jianke, first in seniority among his brothers, age thirty-two, born on the third day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Liao Yongkang, his grandfather was Liao Zhong [National University Student], his father was Liao Kun, his mother was née Liu, and his stepmothers were née Pu, née Liu, and née Yang. His mother is living. His younger brother is Daoguang. He married née Zhang and remarried née Li. He ranked thirteenth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

She Mengli 佘夢鯉 [registered in a military household of Zhendong Guard, Fujian, and a native of Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture; Supernumerary Student of the County School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Youda, sixth in seniority among his brothers, age twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was She Konghui, his grandfather was She Yunzhao, his father was She Kun, and his mother was née Gong. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Yunlong and Yunhong. He married née Yang. He ranked twenty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Xuan 何選 [registered in an official household of the Imperial Academy of Medicine, and a native of Jiading County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; Prefectural Student of Shuntian Prefecture, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jingqing, third in seniority among his brothers, age thirty, born on the third day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was He Xin [Chief Physician of a Princely Establishment], his grandfather was He Xiang [Imperial Physician of the Imperial Academy of Medicine], his father was He Yunfeng [Imperial Physician of the Imperial Academy of Medicine], his father's former wife was née Zhou, and his mother was née Li. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Hui [Medical Practitioner], Qing, Qian [Medical Practitioner with Cap and Belt], Yueling, and Yuexiu; his younger brothers are Zizhong, Yigui, Lin, Zixiao, Guo, Shu, and Di. He married née Zhou. He ranked fortieth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and three hundred thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆十一年進士登科錄
text:
茅國縉〔貫浙江湖州府武康縣民籍歸安縣人國子生治書經字薦卿行二年二十九八月初四日生〕
曾祖珪　祖遷　父坤〔按察司副使〕　嫡母姚氏　生母蕭氏
嚴侍下兄一夔一龍一相一翁一積一桂一楨一臯弟國亨國綬國紀娶蔡氏繼娶陶氏

曾祖成　祖志明　父奉祖〔壽官〕　嫡母劉氏　生母路氏
具慶下　弟永昇　娶楊氏
山東鄉試第八名　會試第二百四十七名

茅國縉〔貫浙江湖州府武康縣民籍，歸安縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字薦卿，行二，年二十九，八月初四日生〕。曾祖珪；祖遷；父坤〔按察司副使〕；嫡母姚氏，生母蕭氏。嚴侍下。兄一夔、一龍、一相、一翁、一積、一桂、一楨、一臯；弟國亨、國綬、國紀。娶蔡氏，繼娶陶氏。順天府鄉試第四十七名，會試第一百九十六名。

于永清〔貫山東濟南府青城縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字源潔，行一，年二十七，三月初三日生〕。曾祖成；祖志明；父奉祖〔壽官〕；嫡母劉氏，生母路氏。具慶下。弟永昇。娶楊氏。山東鄉試第八名，會試第二百四十七名。

賈名儒〔貫直隸真定府真定縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字聘甫，行一，年二十八，十二月初九日生〕。曾祖隆〔封戶部尚書〕；祖應奎〔都司都事〕；父洛〔知縣〕；母趙氏。具慶下。弟名輔。娶梁氏。順天府鄉試第一百二十六名，會試第二百二十三名。

董道醇〔貫浙江湖州府烏程縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子儒，行一，年四十一，七月十七日生〕。曾祖庠〔贈吏部左侍郎兼翰林院學士〕；祖環〔累贈吏部左侍郎兼翰林院學士〕；父份〔禮部尚書兼翰林院學士〕；母顧氏〔累贈夫贈淑人〕，繼母吳氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下。娶茅氏。應天府鄉試第七十三名，會試第一百四十九名。
translation_en:
Mao Guojin 茅國縉 [registered under a civilian household in Wukang County 武康縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江, a native of Gui'an County 歸安縣; a Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Jianqing 薦卿; second in generational seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Mao Gui 珪; his grandfather was Mao Qian 遷; his father is Mao Kun 坤 [ Surveillance Vice Commissioner (anchasi fushi)]; his legal mother was Lady Yao 姚氏, and his birth mother was Lady Xiao 蕭氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Mao Yikui 一夔, Mao Yilong 一龍, Mao Yixiang 一相, Mao Yiweng 一翁, Mao Yiji 一積, Mao Yigui 一桂, Mao Yizhen 一楨, and Mao Yigao 一臯; his younger brothers are Mao Guoheng 國亨, Mao Guoshou 國綬, and Mao Guoji 國紀. He married Lady Cai 蔡氏, and subsequently married Lady Tao 陶氏. He placed forty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Yongqing 于永清 [registered under a military household in Qingcheng County 青城縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; a County Student; specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Yuanjie 源潔; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the third day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Cheng 成; his grandfather was Yu Zhiming 志明; his father is Yu Fengzu 奉祖 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his legal mother is Lady Liu 劉氏, and his birth mother is Lady Lu 路氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Yu Yongsheng 永昇. He married Lady Yang 楊氏. He placed eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jia Mingru 賈名儒 [registered under a military household in Zhending County 真定縣, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, Zhili 直隸; a Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Pingfu 聘甫; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the ninth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Jia Long 隆 [invested as Minister of Revenue (hubu shangshu)]; his grandfather was Jia Yingkui 應奎 [Administrative Clerk of a Regional Military Commission (dusi dushi)]; his father is Jia Luo 洛 [District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his mother is Lady Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Jia Mingfu 名輔. He married Lady Liang 梁氏. He placed one hundred twenty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Daochun 董道醇 [registered under a civilian household in Wucheng County 烏程縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Ziru 子儒; first in generational seniority; aged forty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Xiang 庠 [posthumously honored as Left Vice Minister of Personnel (libu zuo shilang) concurrently Hanlin Academician (hanlinyuan xueshi)]; his grandfather was Dong Huan 環 [successively posthumously honored as Left Vice Minister of Personnel concurrently Hanlin Academician]; his father is Dong Fen 份 [Minister of Rites (libu shangshu) concurrently Hanlin Academician]; his mother was Lady Gu 顧氏 [successively posthumously honored as Lady of Imperial Commands (furen) and Lady of Virtue (shuren) [?]], and his stepmother is Lady Wu 吳氏 [invested as Lady of Virtue (shuren)]. His father and stepmother are both living. He married Lady Mao 茅氏. He placed seventy-third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

朱茗〔貫四川瀘州軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字仲魚，行三，年三十五，八月十九日生〕。曾祖自明〔壽官〕；祖玠〔封刑部主事〕；父子和〔按察司僉事〕；前母易氏〔贈安人〕；母胡氏〔封太安人〕。永感下。兄莢、𧅑、藻〔按察司副使〕、芮、葵、茙、芊、蕢、茝、蔣、萼、艾、藎、茹〔按察司知事〕、芹〔監生〕。娶何氏，繼娶翁氏。四川鄉試第四十七名，會試第二百五十八名。

連標〔貫河南開封府禹州軍籍，州學生，治《書經》，字孟準，行五，年二十六，五月二十三日生〕。曾祖昂；祖吉〔典史〕；父泮〔贈文林郎、知縣〕；母李氏〔贈孺人〕。永感下。兄梧〔訓導〕、格〔知縣〕、楨、栟〔七品散官〕；弟架、槩、梁。娶郭氏。河南鄉試第四十四名，會試第二百四十一名。

張璧〔貫江西袁州府萬載縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字世良，行二，年三十，三月二十二日生〕。曾祖藻鑑；祖義正；父賢傑；前母楊氏；母温氏。慈侍下。娶周氏。江西鄉試第二十一名，會試第一百六十四名。

魯點〔貫湖廣襄陽府南漳縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子與，行一，年二十六，九月二十二日生〕。曾祖邦本〔縣丞〕；祖繼元；父三省；母楊氏。慈侍下。弟熈、鰲。娶王氏。湖廣鄉試第二十七名，會試第七十三名。
translation_en:
Zhu Ming 朱茗 (native of Luzhou, Sichuan, of military registration; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy, specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Zhongyu, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Ziming (Honorary Official Held on Account of Old Age); his grandfather was Zhu Jie (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his father was Zhu Zihe (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner); his father's former wife was Lady Yi (posthumously invested as Mistress of Peace); and his mother was Lady Hu (invested as Dowager Mistress of Peace). Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Zhu Jia, Zhu □ [𧅑], Zhu Zao (Surveillance Vice Commissioner), Zhu Rui, Zhu Kui, Zhu Rong, Zhu Qian, Zhu Kui, Zhu Chai, Zhu Jiang, Zhu E, Zhu Ai, Zhu Jin, Zhu Ru (Archivist of a Surveillance Commission), and Zhu Qin (Imperial Academy Student). He married Lady He, and subsequently married Lady Weng. He ranked forty-seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lian Biao 連標 (native of Yuzhou, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, of military registration; Subprefectural Student, specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Mengzhun, fifth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Lian Ang; his grandfather was Lian Ji (Jail Warden); his father was Lian Pan (posthumously invested as Gentleman-litterateur and District Magistrate); and his mother was Lady Li (posthumously invested as Child Nurturer). Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Lian Wu (Assistant Instructor), Lian Ge (District Magistrate), Lian Zhen, and Lian Bing (Unassigned Official of the Seventh Rank); his younger brothers are Lian Jia, Lian Gai, and Lian Liang. He married Lady Guo. He ranked forty-fourth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Bi 張璧 (native of Wanzai County, Yuanzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, of civilian registration; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shiliang, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the twenty-second day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Zaojian; his grandfather was Zhang Yizheng; his father was Zhang Xianjie; his father's former wife was Lady Yang; and his mother is Lady Wen. His mother is living. He married Lady Zhou. He ranked twenty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Dian 魯點 (native of Nanzhang County, Xiangyang Prefecture, Huguang, of civilian registration; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Ziyu, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Lu Bangben (Vice Magistrate); his grandfather was Lu Jiyuan; his father was Lu Sanxing; and his mother is Lady Yang. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Lu Xi and Lu Ao. He married Lady Wang. He ranked twenty-seventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

程訓〔貫河南汝州郟縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字君誨，行四，年三十四，二月初九日生〕。曾祖芳；祖印；父應汝；母馬氏。慈侍下。兄詔、誥、論；弟諭、讓、訥。娶王氏。河南鄉試第七十一名，會試第二百七十七名。
李杜才〔貫河南南陽府南召縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字鳴儒，行三，年二十八，十二月初七日生〕。曾祖學〔太僕寺寺丞〕；祖暘〔儒官〕；父據德；母張氏。慈侍下。兄杜詩〔儒官〕、杜文〔歲貢生〕。娶杜氏。河南鄉試第十九名，會試第三百十名。
蔡肇慶〔貫福建漳州府詔安縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字以祥，行二，年二十四，六月十二日生〕。曾祖廷深；祖懋；父會治；母田氏。重慶下。兄進仁；弟肇言、進忠、進應、進惠。娶黃氏。福建鄉試第十八名，會試第二百九十七名。
湯顯祖〔貫江西撫州府臨川縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字義仍，行二，年二十七，八月十四日生〕。曾祖瑄；祖懋昭；父尚賢；母吳氏。具慶下。弟儒祖、鳳祖、會祖、良祖。娶吳氏。江西鄉試第八名，會試第六十五名。
translation_en:
Cheng Xun 程訓 [registered in a civilian household of Jia County 郟縣, Ruzhou 汝州, Henan; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Junhui 君誨; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the ninth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Cheng Fang 程芳; his grandfather was Cheng Yin 程印; his father was Cheng Yingru 程應汝; and his mother was née Ma 馬氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Cheng Zhao 程詔, Cheng Gao 程誥, and Cheng Lun 程論; his younger brothers are Cheng Yu 程諭, Cheng Rang 程讓, and Cheng Ne 程訥. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed 71st in the Henan Provincial Examination and 277th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Ducai 李杜才 [registered in a civilian household of Nanzhao County 南召縣, Nanyang Prefecture 南陽府, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Mingru 鳴儒; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the seventh day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Xue 李學 [Assistant Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud]; his grandfather was Li Yang 李暘 [Confucian Official]; his father was Li Jude 李據德; and his mother was née Zhang 張氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Dushi 李杜詩 [Confucian Official] and Li Duwen 李杜文 [Annual Tribute Student (suigong sheng)]. He married née Du 杜氏. He placed 19th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 310th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Zhaoqing 蔡肇慶 [registered in a civilian household of Zhao'an County 詔安縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian; County Student (xianxue sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Yixiang 以祥; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-four, born on the twelfth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Cai Tingshen 蔡廷深; his grandfather was Cai Mao 蔡懋; his father was Cai Huizhi 蔡會治; and his mother was née Tian 田氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His elder brother is Cai Jinren 蔡進仁; his younger brothers are Cai Zhaoyan 蔡肇言, Cai Jinzhong 蔡進忠, Cai Jinying 蔡進應, and Cai Jinhui 蔡進惠. He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed 18th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 297th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Xianzu 湯顯祖 [registered in a civilian household of Linchuan County 臨川縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yireng 義仍; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Tang Xuan 湯瑄; his grandfather was Tang Maozhao 湯懋昭; his father was Tang Shangxian 湯尚賢; and his mother was née Wu 吳氏. Both his parents are living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Tang Ruzu 湯儒祖, Tang Fengzu 湯鳳祖, Tang Huizu 湯會祖, and Tang Liangzu 湯良祖. He married née Wu 吳氏. He placed 8th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 65th in the Metropolitan Examination.

徐應聘〔貫直隸蘇州府崐山縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字伯衡，行一，年二十六，八月二十日生〕。曾祖申〔刑部主事〕；祖一元〔縣主簿〕；父汝龍，母顧氏。具慶下。弟應達、應時。娶丘氏。應天府鄉試第一百九名，會試第三百五名。

林寅賓〔貫福建泉州府晋江縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字爾亮，行一，年三十，八月二十五日生〕。曾祖宗；祖肅〔壽官〕；父養材，母劉氏。慈侍下。兄昇，弟嘉賓、國憲、獻賓、利賓、士賓、國俊、彥賓、堯賓、應賓、舜賓。娶傅氏。福建鄉試第三名，會試第八十四名。

曹一元〔貫湖廣荊州府江陵縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字慎夫，行一，年三十六，閏九月二十六日生〕。曾祖文桂；祖鈒；父天應，母尹氏。具慶下。弟一愷、一亨、一永、一雋、一貞。娶秦氏，繼娶喬氏。湖廣鄉試第五十名，會試第一百六十七名。

梅國樓〔貫湖廣黃州府麻城縣民籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字公岑，行二，年二十九，八月十四日生〕。曾祖玉鼎〔贈兵部郎中〕；祖吉〔知府〕；父汝觀，母陳氏。重慶下。兄國楨〔同科進士〕，弟國森〔貢士〕、國楹、國棨、國林。娶黃氏。湖廣鄉試第七十六名，會試第三十二名。
translation_en:
Xu Ying聘 徐應聘 [registered in Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under civilian household status; anAdded Student (zengguang sheng) of the county school specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Boheng, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Shen [Secretary in the Ministry of Justice], his grandfather was Xu Yiyuan [County Recorder], his father is Xu Rulong, and his mother is née Gu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yingda and Yingshi. He is married to née Qiu. He placed 109th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 305th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Yinbin 林寅賓 [registered in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under civilian household status; an Added Student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Erliang, first in seniority, aged thirty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Zong, his grandfather was Lin Su [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)], his father was Lin Yangcai, and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living. His elder brother is Sheng, and his younger brothers are Jiabin, Guoxian, Xianbin, Libin, Shibin, Guojun, Yanbin, Yaobin, Yingbin, and Shunbin. He is married to née Fu. He placed 3rd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 84th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Yiyuan 曹一元 [registered in Jiangling County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang, under civilian household status; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shenfu, first in seniority, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-sixth day of the intercalary ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Cao Wengui, his grandfather was Cao Sa, his father is Cao Tianying, and his mother is née Yin. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yikai, Yiheng, Yiyong, Yijun, and Yizhen. He was married to née Qin, and remarried to née Qiao. He placed 50th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 167th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mei Guolou 梅國樓 [registered in Macheng County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang, under civilian household status; a County School Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Gongcen, second in seniority, aged twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Mei Yuding [posthumously honored as Director in the Ministry of War], his grandfather is Mei Ji [Prefect], his father is Mei Ruguan, and his mother is née Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Guozhen [a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of this same examination class], and his younger brothers are Guosen [a tribute student / metropolitan examination graduate awaiting palace examination (gongshi)], Guoying, Guoqi, and Guolin. He is married to née Huang. He placed 76th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 32nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

聶應科〔貫江西瑞州府上高縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字廷傑，行七，年二十六，六月十三日生〕。曾祖珙〔按察司副使〕；祖興方；父濟貞；母黃氏。具慶下。兄應乾、應夏，弟應坎、應彦、應允、應艮、應巽。娶蒙氏，繼娶羅氏。江西鄉試第八十七名，會試第二百三十一名。

嚴貞度〔貫直隸蘇州府嘉定縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字茂肅，行三，年二十九，五月初五日生〕。曾祖昊〔壽官〕；祖塾；父鑑；母談氏。具慶下。兄泰、貞亮，弟貞言、貞立、貞憲。娶周氏。應天府鄉試第十名，會試第六名。

錢景超〔貫浙江寧波府慈谿縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字世功，行十四，年二十九，三月二十三日生〕。曾祖涇；祖宗傑；父瑩；母陳氏。具慶下。兄景隆、景著，弟景起、景趨、景奎、景越、景莊。娶黃氏。浙江鄉試第七十九名，會試第一百六名。

熊元〔貫河南汝寧府光州民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子貞，行一，年三十六，十二月二十九日生〕。曾祖仁；祖琳；父夢相；母胡氏。永感下。娶劉氏。河南鄉試第三十三名，會試第三百十五名。
translation_en:
Nie Yingke 聶應科 (registered in a civilian household of Shanggao County 上高縣, Ruizhou Prefecture 瑞州府, Jiangxi 江西; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tingjie 廷傑; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Nie Gong 聶珙 ( Surveillance Vice Commissioner); his grandfather was Nie Xingfang 聶興方; his father is Nie Jizhen 聶濟貞; his mother is Lady Huang 黃氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yingqian 應乾 and Yingxia 應夏; his younger brothers are Yingkan 應坎, Yingyan 應彦, Yingyun 應允, Yinggen 應艮, and Yingxun 應巽. He married Lady Meng 蒙氏, and remarried Lady Luo 羅氏. He placed 87th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 231st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Zhendu 嚴貞度 (registered in a civilian household of Jiading County 嘉定縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a Supernumerary County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Maosu 茂肅; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Yan Hao 嚴昊 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Yan Shu 嚴塾; his father is Yan Jian 嚴鑑; his mother is Lady Tan 談氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Tai 泰 and Zhenliang 貞亮; his younger brothers are Zhenyan 貞言, Zhenli 貞立, and Zhenxian 貞憲. He married Lady Zhou 周氏. He placed 10th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 6th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Jingchao 錢景超 (registered in a civilian household of Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shigong 世功; fourteenth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-third day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Qian Jing 錢涇; his grandfather was Qian Zongjie 錢宗傑; his father is Qian Ying 錢瑩; his mother is Lady Chen 陳氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Jinglong 景隆 and Jingzhu 景著; his younger brothers are Jingqi 景起, Jingqu 景趨, Jingkui 景奎, Jingyue 景越, and Jingzhuang 景莊. He married Lady Huang 黃氏. He placed 79th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 106th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Yuan 熊元 (registered in a civilian household of Guang Subprefecture 光州, Runing Prefecture 汝寧府, Henan 河南; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zizhen 子貞; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xiong Ren 熊仁; his grandfather was Xiong Lin 熊琳; his father was Xiong Mengxiang 熊夢相; his mother was Lady Hu 胡氏. Both parents are deceased. He married Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed 33rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 315th in the Metropolitan Examination.

嚴侍下兄園國〔省祭官〕圍〔省祭官〕振田揚〔省祭官〕擢弟團娶侯氏繼娶王氏

徐圖　貫山東萊州府掖縣民籍　國子生
治詩經字君猷行三年二十四四月初八日生
曾祖謙　祖漢　父守道〔倉副使〕　母鞠氏　繼母史氏
嚴侍下　兄園國〔省祭官〕　圃〔省祭官〕　振〔省祭官〕　田　揚〔省祭官〕　擢　弟圍　娶侯氏　繼娶王氏

永感下　兄學文　學書　學詩　學武　弟學價　學佃　娶諸葛氏

punctuated:
張宗載〔貫雲南鶴慶府民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字一寧，行二，年二十八，九月二十一日生〕。曾祖連；祖銳；父應舉〔學正〕；母楊氏。慈侍下。弟宗栻。娶李氏，繼娶李氏。雲南鄉試第十名，會試第七十七名。

李甲〔貫陝西鳳翔府寶鷄縣民籍，陝西城固縣學訓導，治《春秋》，字伯始，行一，年三十九，十一月初六日生〕。曾祖棠〔壽官〕；祖克恭〔壽官〕；父一陽〔倉大使〕；前母韓氏，母高氏。慈侍下。兄科、選，弟由、秋、田。娶陳氏。陝西鄉試第十七名，會試第三百六名。

徐圖〔貫山東萊州府掖縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字君猷，行三，年二十四，四月初八日生〕。曾祖謙；祖漢；父守道〔倉副使〕；母鞠氏，繼母史氏。嚴侍下。兄園、國〔省祭官〕、圍〔省祭官〕、振、田、揚〔省祭官〕、擢，弟團。娶侯氏，繼娶王氏。山東鄉試第四十名，會試第二百二十五名。

趙學仕〔貫浙江金華府蘭谿縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字信甫，行五，年四十四，四月二十八日生〕。曾祖震；祖貫；父瑾；母王氏。永感下。兄學文、學書、學詩、學武，弟學價、學佃。娶諸葛氏。浙江鄉試第八十七名，會試第一百六十一名。
translation_en:
Zhang Zongzai 張宗載 [native of Heqing Prefecture, Yunnan, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yining; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Lian 連; his grandfather was Rui 銳; his father was Yingju 應舉 [Subprefectural Director of Studies]; and his mother is née Yang 楊. His mother is living. His younger brother is Zongshi 宗栻. He married Lady Li 李, and remarried another Lady Li 李. He placed tenth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jia 李甲 [native of Baoji County, Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi, of civilian registration; an Assistant Instructor in the Confucian School of Chenggu County, Shaanxi, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Boshi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the sixth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Tang 棠 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age]; his grandfather was Kegong 克恭 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age]; his father was Yiyang 一陽 [Granary Commissioner-in-chief]; his father's former wife was née Han 韓, and his mother is née Gao 高. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Ke 科 and Xuan 選, and his younger brothers are You 由, Qiu 秋, and Tian 田. He married Lady Chen 陳. He placed seventeenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and three hundred and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Tu 徐圖 [native of Ye County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Junyou; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the eighth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Qian 謙; his grandfather was Han 漢; his father is Shoudao 守道 [Assistant Granary Commissioner]; his mother was née Ju 鞠, and his stepmother was née Shi 史. His father is living. His elder brothers are Yuan 園, Guo 國 [Subordinate Ritual Officer], Wei 圍 [Subordinate Ritual Officer], Zhen 振, Tian 田, Yang 揚 [Subordinate Ritual Officer], and Zhuo 擢, and his younger brother is Tuan 團. He married Lady Hou 侯, and remarried Lady Wang 王. He placed fortieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Xueshi 趙學仕 [native of Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, of military registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xinfu; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhen 震; his grandfather was Guan 貫; his father was Jin 瑾; and his mother was née Wang 王. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Xuewen 學文, Xueshu 學書, Xueshi 學詩, and Xuewu 學武, and his younger brothers are Xuejia 學價 and Xuedian 學佃. He married Lady Zhuge 諸葛. He placed eighty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆十一年進士登科錄

曾祖模〔封文林郎南京兵馬司指揮〕　祖汝文　父煒〔歲貢生〕　母李氏　繼母易氏

李用中〔貫河南開封府杞縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字舜智，行二，年二十九，十月初九日生〕。曾祖霆〔驛丞〕，祖經綸，父思敬，母杜氏。具慶下。兄得雲、尚和，弟節和、原孝、用康。娶吳氏。河南鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百七十七名。

曹學程〔貫廣西桂林府全州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字希明，行四，年三十，十一月初一日生〕。曾祖穟，祖鶠，父體元，母蔣氏。具慶下。兄學思、學參〔知縣〕、學臯，弟學蘇〔貢士〕、學朱、學易〔貢士〕、學雍。娶郭氏。廣西鄉試第七名，會試第一百九十一名。

趙任〔貫山東萊州府膠州軍籍，州學生，治《禮記》，字仁甫，行一，年二十五，八月十三日生〕。曾祖從龍〔府同知，進階朝列大夫〕，祖白璧，父懷慎，母宋氏。重慶下。弟僖、佐、佑、儼、伸。娶閻氏。山東鄉試第四名，會試第二百九十三名。

樊玉衡〔貫湖廣黃州府黃岡縣軍籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字欽之，行一，年二十七，四月十七日生〕。曾祖模〔封文林郎、南京兵馬司指揮〕，祖汝文，父煒〔歲貢生〕，母李氏，繼母易氏。具慶下。弟玉衝、玉衢、玉銜、玉衎。娶熊氏。湖廣鄉試第三名，會試第一百三名。
translation_en:
Li Yongzhong 李用中 (registered as a commoner in Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Shunzhi; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the ninth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Ting (Postal Relay Station Master), his grandfather was Li Jinglun, his father was Li Sijing, and his mother was née Du. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Deyun and Shanghe, and his younger brothers are Jiehe, Yuanxiao, and Yongkang. He married née Wu. He placed twenty-fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Xuecheng 曹學程 (registered as a commoner in Quanzhou Department, Guilin Prefecture, Guangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Ximing; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the first day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Cao Sui, his grandfather was Cao Yan, his father was Cao Tiyuan, and his mother was née Jiang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Xuesi, Xueshen (District Magistrate), and Xuegao, and his younger brothers are Xuesu (tribute scholar), Xuezhu, Xueyi (tribute scholar), and Xueyong. He married née Guo. He placed seventh in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Ren 趙任 (registered in a military household in Jiaozhou Department, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; Department Student; specialized in the Record of Rites; courtesy name Renfu; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Conglong (Prefectural Vice Prefect, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master for Courtier Ranks), his grandfather was Zhao Baibi, his father was Zhao Huaishen, and his mother was née Song. Both parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Xi, Zuo, You, Yan, and Shen. He married née Yan. He placed fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Yuheng 樊玉衡 (registered in a military household in Huanggang County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; County Student; specialized in the Record of Rites; courtesy name Qinzhi; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the seventeenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Fan Mo (invested as Gentleman for Literature and Warden of a Nanjing Ward), his grandfather was Fan Ruwen, his father was Fan Wei (Annual Tribute Student), his mother was née Li, and his stepmother was née Yi. Both father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Yuchong, Yuqu, Yuxian, and Yukan. He married née Xiong. He placed third in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred third in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆十一年進士登科錄
text:
涂文煥〔貫江西南昌府奉新縣民籍國子生治詩經字本充行八年三十六五月二十日生〕
曾祖萬欽祖孔義父守正母陳氏
永感下兄文南文伯文棟弟文忠娶黃氏繼娶袁氏
江西鄉試第八十七名會試第一百八十八名

曾祖瑛〔壽官〕祖泰〔贈工部郎中〕父貢〔刑部郎中〕母唐氏〔贈宜人〕繼母申氏〔封宜人〕
慈侍下弟夢衡夢徵夢律娶呂氏

涂文煥〔貫江西南昌府奉新縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字本充，行八，年三十六，五月二十日生〕。曾祖萬欽；祖孔義；父守正；母陳氏。永感下。兄文南、文伯、文棟，弟文忠。娶黃氏，繼娶袁氏。江西鄉試第八十七名，會試第一百八十八名。

錢夢得〔貫浙江嘉興府桐鄉縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字國賢，行四，年三十，九月初七日生〕。曾祖瑛〔壽官〕；祖泰〔贈工部郎中〕；父貢〔刑部郎中〕；母唐氏〔贈宜人〕，繼母申氏〔封宜人〕。慈侍下。弟夢衡、夢徵、夢律。娶呂氏。順天府鄉試第十七名，會試第五十六名。

鄧宗齡〔貫廣東雷州府徐聞縣民籍，儒士，治《書經》，字子振，行一，年二十二，四月二十日生〕。曾祖植〔監生〕；祖煥〔儒官〕；父邦基〔通判〕；母張氏。重慶下。弟宗京。娶莫氏。廣東鄉試第六十一名，會試第五十名。

劉大武〔貫山東東昌府博平縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字定甫，行二，年二十八，九月初八日生〕。曾祖資；祖舉；父尚德〔省祭官〕；母李氏。具慶下。兄大文〔貢士〕，弟大典、大訓。娶謝氏。山東鄉試第三十名，會試第二百七十八名。
translation_en:
Tu Wenhuan 涂文煥 (registered in a civilian household of Fengxin County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Benchong; eighth in his generation; age thirty-six, born on the twentieth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Tu Wanqin; his grandfather was Tu Kongyi; his father was Tu Shouzheng; and his mother was Lady Chen. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Tu Wennan, Tu Wenbo, and Tu Wendong; his younger brother is Tu Wenzhong. He married Lady Huang, and subsequently married Lady Yuan. He ranked eighty-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Mengde 錢夢得 (registered in a civilian household of Tongxiang County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Guoxian; fourth in his generation; age thirty, born on the seventh day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Qian Ying (Honorary Officer for Longevity); his grandfather was Qian Tai (posthumously honoured as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Works); his father was Qian Gong (Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice); his mother was Lady Tang (posthumously honoured as Lady of Suitability), and his stepmother is Lady Shen (invested as Lady of Suitability). His mother (or stepmother) is living. His younger brothers are Qian Mengheng, Qian Mengzheng, and Qian Menglü. He married Lady Lü. He ranked seventeenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Deng Zongling 鄧宗齡 (registered in a civilian household of Xuwen County, Leizhou Prefecture, Guangdong; Confucian Scholar; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zizhen; first in his generation; age twenty-two, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Deng Zhi (National University Student); his grandfather was Deng Huan (Confucian Official); his father is Deng Bangji (Assistant Prefect); and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Deng Zongjing. He married Lady Mo. He ranked sixty-first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Dawu 劉大武 (registered in a military household of Boping County, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dingfu; second in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Zi; his grandfather was Liu Ju; his father is Liu Shangde (Sacrificial Attendant); and his mother is Lady Li. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Dawen (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are Liu Dadian and Liu Daxun. He married Lady Xie. He ranked thirtieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

杜廕〔貫直隸廣平府永年縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字舜延，行四，年三十一，三月二十日生〕。曾祖春；祖浩〔贈奉直大夫、刑部員外郎〕；父秉彞〔知府〕；前母韓氏〔贈宜人〕；母王氏〔封宜人〕。嚴侍下。兄廓〔貢士〕、賡、序；弟庇〔俱監生〕、縻〔知縣〕、庄、庥。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第四十九名，會試第二百六十七名。

translation_en:
Jiang Yinglin 姜應麟 [registered under a military household in Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ziwen 子文; ninth in his generation; age thirty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Jiang Jin 錦; his grandfather was Jiang Huai 槐 [posthumously honored as Grand Master for Governance (fengzheng dafu) and Assistant Surveillance Commissioner (anchasi qianshi)]; his father was Jiang Guohua 國華 [Right Assistant Administration Commissioner (buzhengsi you canyi)]; his mother was Lady Wang 王氏 [invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. His father is alive. His elder brothers are Yinglong 應龍 and Yingqi 應麒; his younger brothers are Yinglin 應霖, Yingzhen 應震, Yingfeng 應鳳, Yingdou 應斗, Yingluan 應鸞, Yingzheng 應徵, and Yingping 應聘. He married Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed 58th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 71st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Yin 杜廕 [registered under a civilian household in Yongnian County 永年縣, Guangping Prefecture 廣平府, Southern or Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shunyan 舜延; fourth in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the twentieth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Du Chun 春; his grandfather was Du Hao 浩 [posthumously honored as Grand Master for Fostering Uprightness (fengzhi dafu) and Vice Director (yuanwailang) in the Ministry of Justice (Xingbu)]; his father was Du Bingyi 秉彞 [Prefect (zhifu)]; his father's first wife was Lady Han 韓氏 [posthumously honored as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]; his mother was Lady Wang 王氏 [invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. His father is alive. His elder brothers are Kuo 廓 [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Geng 賡, and Xu 序; his younger brothers are Bi 庇 [along with Geng and Xu, all National University Students (jiansheng)], Mi 縻 [District Magistrate (zhixian)], Zhuang 庄, and Xiu 庥. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed 49th in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 267th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Xu 陳勗 [registered under a civilian household in Ju Subprefecture 莒州, Qingzhou Prefecture 青州府, Shandong 山東; student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dianbo 典伯; first in his generation; age thirty, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Kun 琨 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his grandfather was Chen Zhen 真; his father was Chen Liangfu 良輔 [District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his mother was Lady Duan 段氏. His father is alive. His younger brothers are Quan 勸 and Zhu 助. He married Lady Jiang 蔣氏. He placed 1st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 195th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tingxiang 張廷相 [registered under a military household in Jinxi County 金谿縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi 江西; Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhong 以忠; seventy-third in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Wei 煒; his grandfather was Zhang Huan 瓛 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his father was Zhang Chun 純; his father's first wife was Lady Chen 陳氏; his mother was Lady Rao 饒氏. His mother is alive. His elder brothers are Tang 湯, Tingwen 廷文, Zhan 湛, and Tingwu 廷武; his younger brother is Bing 冰. He married Lady Qiu 丘氏. He placed 8th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 333rd in the Metropolitan Examination.
